column1: A slender, poised woman, one of the Greek fates, with porcelain-pale skin, amber eyes and red lips. Her golden-blond hair is shaped into a full, rounded bob with a thick braid circling her head, and two bright green coils of thread are wound into the hair either side of her face. She wears a high-necked, close-fitting white suit with fine pinstripes, black gloves, and from her waist hangs a tall, heavy cylinder of a skirt woven in a dark grey lattice, open at the front over her bare legs. In one hand she holds a black-and-gold handle trailing a single fine thread. Cool, precise and quietly ominous.
column2: 一位身形纖細、儀態從容的女子，是希臘命運女神之一，有著瓷白的肌膚、琥珀色的眼睛和紅唇。金黃色的頭髮修成飽滿圓潤的鮑伯頭，一條粗辮子繞著頭頂一圈，臉龐兩側的髮絲裡纏著兩圈亮綠色的線。她穿著高領貼身的白色細條紋套裝和黑手套，腰間垂著一條又高又重的圓筒長裙，以深灰色格紋編成，正面敞開，露出光裸的雙腿。她一隻手握著黑金相間的把手，下方拖著一條細線。冷靜、精準，隱隱帶著不祥。

column1: An immense winged serpent of Aztec legend, impossibly long and thin, its whole body covered in pale sea-green scales. Behind its head bursts a great upright fan of frosty, pale blue feathers, and two vast, slender wings of white and lavender-grey feathers spread wide on either side. Its head is a snake's, with glowing red eyes and wide-open jaws showing a pink mouth and sharp fangs, and its body stretches on and on behind it into a fine, tapering tail. Majestic, airy and divine, a feathered god of the sky and wind.
column2: 一條阿茲特克傳說中的巨大有翼蛇，長得不可思議，身形細長，全身覆滿淡海綠色的鱗片。頭後方豎起一大片霜藍色的羽毛，如扇般展開，兩側各伸展著一對寬大而修長的翅膀，羽毛是白色與淡紫灰色。牠有蛇的腦袋，眼睛閃著紅光，大口張開，露出粉紅色的口腔和尖牙，身體在身後一路延伸，逐漸收成纖細的尾巴。威嚴、輕盈而神聖，是掌管天空與風的羽蛇神。

column1: A giant tortoise, one of the four Chinese guardian beasts, with a broad, domed shell of deep teal-black plates outlined in glowing magenta-pink lines. Beneath it are thick, tan, scaly legs with sharp claws, and a long-necked tan head with green eyes, a curved beak, small fangs and a dark, bristly beard hanging below its chin. From its rear stretches an enormously long serpent, scaled in red-orange with a row of dark spikes along its back, ending in a fierce, maned, red-orange snake's head facing backwards. Steady, ancient and unbreakable, a fortress that keeps a snake on guard behind it.
column2: 一隻巨大的烏龜，中國四大守護神獸之一，寬闊的圓頂龜殼由深青黑色的甲片組成，邊緣勾著發光的洋紅粉色線條。殼下是粗壯、黃褐色、帶鱗的腿，爪子鋒利；長頸的黃褐色頭部有綠色的眼睛、彎曲的喙、小尖牙，下巴垂著一撮深色的硬鬚。尾部延伸出一條極長的蛇，覆著紅橙色的鱗片，背上有一排深色尖刺，蛇頭兇猛，長著鬃毛，同為紅橙色，朝向後方。沉穩、古老、堅不可摧，是一座身後留著蛇來警戒的要塞。

column1: A burly guardian king of Buddhist temples with dark blue skin, a deeply scowling face, sharp white eyes and heavy brows. His black hair is pulled into a high topknot, held by a flame-shaped red and gold crown ornament. He wears armour of maroon plates over orange robes: a sculpted breastplate, shoulder guards shaped like beasts' heads, a long maroon armoured skirt, a white sash knotted at his waist, white sleeves, orange trousers bound with dark straps and black shoes. In one hand he holds a writing brush, in the other a green scroll. Grim, watchful and severe, he notes down everyone's misdeeds.
column2: 一位魁梧的佛寺護法天王，皮膚深藍，面容兇狠地皺著眉，白色的眼睛銳利，眉毛濃重。黑髮盤成高髻，以火焰形的紅金色冠飾固定。他穿著栗紅色甲片的盔甲，罩在橙色長袍外：雕塑般的胸甲、獸頭形的護肩、長長的栗紅色甲裙、腰間打結的白色腰帶、白色衣袖、以深色皮帶綁住的橙色長褲和黑鞋。他一手持著毛筆，另一手拿著綠色卷軸。冷峻、警覺、嚴厲，一一記下每個人的過錯。

column1: A magnificent golden dragon of Chinese legend, with a long, sinuous, scaled body stretching far behind it to a pointed tail, a row of small spines along its back. Its head bristles with a spiky mane of golden whiskers, wide, glaring red eyes and a snarling mouth of fine teeth, and above it rises a towering crown of antlers: branching golden horns around a tall, V-shaped crest. Each of its four clawed feet grips a large glossy orb, one red, one blue, one smoky black and one pale lavender. Radiant, imperial and overwhelming, the emperor of all dragons.
column2: 一條華麗的中國傳說金龍，長長的身體蜿蜒帶鱗，一路延伸到身後尖尖的尾巴，背上有一排小刺。頭上豎著一圈尖銳的金色長鬚，眼睛又大又紅，怒目圓睜，嘴巴露出細密的牙齒猙獰咆哮，頭頂升起一頂高聳的鹿角冠：分岔的金色犄角圍著一個高高的 V 形頂飾。四隻帶爪的腳各抓著一顆光亮的大珠，分別是紅色、藍色、煙黑色和淡紫色。光輝、尊貴、威壓全場，是眾龍之帝。

column1: A floating spirit shaped like a fat golden comma or a magatama bead: a smooth, round egg of glossy yellow-gold whose top sweeps sideways into a long, curling, tapering tail, like a teardrop caught by the wind. On the round end sits a calm, gentle face moulded into the gold, with a small straight nose, thin arched black brows, eyes closed in contented upturned crescents and a soft, closed-lipped smile. No body, limbs or clothes, just that one bright, polished shape. It radiates serene, sunny happiness, a little drop of pure good fortune.
column2: 一個漂浮的精靈，形狀像一顆肥胖的金色逗號或勾玉：光滑圓潤的蛋形，閃著金黃色光澤，上端向一側掠出一條長長捲曲、逐漸變細的尾巴，像被風吹彎的淚滴。圓形的一端是金身塑成的一張平靜溫和的臉，有小巧挺直的鼻子、細細拱起的黑眉、閉成滿足彎月形的雙眼，以及輕輕閉著嘴的微笑。沒有身體、四肢，也沒有衣物，只有那一團明亮、光潤的形體。散發著寧靜、陽光般的幸福，彷彿一小滴純粹的好運。

column1: A slender, alluring demon woman with shoulder-length wavy dark blonde hair, pointed elfin ears, pale skin, vivid blue eyes and dark painted lips. A black choker with a little red heart charm circles her throat. She wears a skin-tight, high-necked black leotard cut very high on the hips and open at the sides and back, long black opera gloves and black thigh-high boots, with a thin shackle chain at one ankle. Huge bat wings, dark crimson on the inside and navy black outside, rise far above her head, and a long, whip-thin black tail ends in an arrowhead spade. A seductive nightmare, playful and dangerous.
column2: 一位身形纖細、嫵媚的惡魔女子，有及肩的深金色波浪長髮、尖尖的精靈耳、白皙的皮膚、鮮豔的藍眼睛和塗成深色的雙唇。頸間繫著一條黑色頸圈，掛著一個紅色小愛心墜飾。她穿著緊身、高領的黑色連身衣，臀部剪裁極高，兩側和背後鏤空，配上黑色長手套和黑色過膝長靴，一邊腳踝繫著一條細細的鐐銬鏈。巨大的蝙蝠翅膀從頭頂高高升起，內側是深紅色，外側是藏青黑色，一條長長、鞭子般細的黑色尾巴末端是箭頭形的黑桃。誘人的夢魘，頑皮而危險。

column1: A colossal fallen-angel serpent: a long, thick, dark navy-blue tail, ridged and scaled, sweeps away behind, and from it rises a lean, muscular dark blue torso with a horned, fanged demon face, a single gold point gleaming in its brow. Around it fan rows of huge folded wings, deep blue outside and blood red within, stacked like the ribs of a palm, with pale, steely blades jutting between them and tall spikes standing up behind its armoured, segmented crest. Two enormously long, thin, jointed bone-grey spines stretch down from its sides. Vast, dark and apocalyptic, it looks like the end of the world arriving.
column2: 一條巨大的墮天使蛇：一條又長又粗的深藏青色尾巴，布滿脊紋與鱗片，在身後蜿蜒遠去，尾巴上升起一副精瘦、肌肉結實的深藍色上身，頂著長角、獠牙外露的惡魔臉孔，眉心閃著一個金色尖點。四周如扇般展開一排排巨大的收攏翅膀，外側深藍、內側血紅，如棕櫚的肋骨般層層疊起，翅膀之間探出蒼白、鋼鐵色的利刃，高聳的尖刺矗立在帶甲、分節的冠飾後方。兩條極長、細瘦、有關節的骨灰色脊刺從兩側向下延伸。龐大、陰暗、末日般，彷彿世界終結正在降臨。

column1: A slender, graceful goddess in black from head to toe. Her chin-length black bob is crowned by a black cap edged with a scalloped band of gold medallions and dangling drops, and a black veil hides her face below the eyes, which are a striking deep pink-red; thin gold chains loop from the veil. Her long-sleeved black gown wraps across the chest with a ribbed gold trim, a scalloped gold belt sits at her waist, and the skirt splits high at the front over bare pale legs and black harem trousers, ringed with gold bands down to her bare feet. Mysterious and composed, a veiled goddess wrapped in quiet fire.
column2: 一位纖細優雅的女神，從頭到腳一身黑。她齊下巴的黑色鮑伯頭上戴著黑帽，帽緣是一圈扇貝形的金色圓牌和垂墜的水滴飾，黑色面紗遮住眼睛以下的臉，雙眼是鮮明的深粉紅色；細細的金鏈從面紗垂掛成環。她的黑色長袖長袍在胸前交疊，鑲著羅紋金邊，腰間繫著扇貝形的金腰帶，裙子在正面高高開衩，露出白皙的光腿和黑色燈籠褲，褲管下方一路環著金環，直到赤腳。神祕、沉靜，一位裹著安靜火焰的蒙面女神。

column1: A tall, lean, muscular figure whose whole body is patterned like an anatomy chart: bright red muscle panels framed by pale bone-grey bands with crisp white outlines, over chest, arms and legs. The bald head is red at the crown, sweeping back into a tall curved crest, with a pale grey face, sharp blue eyes and an open red mouth. The hands are smooth red mitts with no fingers, the legs taper into pointed red feet, and a perfectly round black orb sits in the hollow of its belly like a hole into nothing. It looks like an ancient Roman god of time and harvest, stern, strange and slightly unsettling.
column2: 一個高大、精瘦、肌肉結實的身影，整個身體像一張解剖圖：胸口、手臂和雙腿上是鮮紅的肌肉區塊，以淡骨灰色的條帶框住，並描著清晰的白色輪廓。光禿的頭頂是紅色，向後掠成一道高高彎曲的冠脊，臉是淡灰色，眼睛銳利藍色，嘴巴張開，是紅色的。雙手是沒有手指的光滑紅色連指手套，雙腿逐漸收成尖尖的紅色腳掌，肚子的凹處嵌著一顆全圓的黑球，像一個通往虛無的洞。看起來像古羅馬的時間與收穫之神，嚴肅、怪異，略讓人不安。

column1: A huge, flat, crimson serpent built like a living spearhead: a long blade-thin body of rough red hide, striped with diagonal black bands and with a dark purple underside, tapering behind into a needle-sharp tail. Its broad, blunt head is cracked and craggy, with a short horn on top and a cluster of glossy blue eyes, one large in the centre and smaller ones around it, above a dark purple lower jaw. Long, thin, ribbed red struts spread from its shoulders like the bones of folded wings, each ending in a hooked claw. Sleek, alien and venomous, it looks like death gliding in.
column2: 一條巨大、扁平、深紅色的蛇，形如一柄活的矛頭：長長的刀刃般薄的身體，覆著粗糙的紅色外皮，帶有斜向的黑色條紋，腹面為深紫色，向後收成針尖般的尾巴。寬闊鈍圓的頭部布滿裂痕，崎嶇不平，頂上有一根短角，一簇光亮的藍眼睛聚在一起，中間一隻大的，周圍是較小的，下方是深紫色的下顎。細長、帶肋紋的紅色支架從肩膀向外伸展，像折起的翅膀骨架，每一根末端都有一個彎鉤爪。流線、異形、帶毒，彷彿死亡正悄然滑行而來。

column1: A graceful goddess of music and learning with warm brown skin, long black hair, blue eyes and gold-painted lips. On her head sits a tall golden crown set with blue gems, topped by a pointed golden urn and framed behind by a gleaming golden halo ring. She wears a high-necked emerald-green top with gold-and-black striped borders, white short sleeves and a white overskirt trimmed in gold stripes, a gold belt studded with sapphires, and full, pleated green harem trousers gathered at bare ankles. Beside her floats a long-necked wooden sitar, and pale ribbons of silk drift at her shoulders. Serene and refined, she looks like a song made visible.
column2: 一位優雅的音樂與學問女神，有著溫暖的棕色肌膚、烏黑長髮、藍色眼睛和塗成金色的嘴唇。頭上戴著鑲有藍寶石的高聳金冠，頂端是一個尖尖的金甕，後方環著一圈閃亮的金色光環。她穿著高領的翠綠上衣，滾著金黑條紋的邊，白色短袖，白色外裙綴有金色條紋，腰間是鑲著藍寶石的金腰帶，下身是寬鬆的褶皺綠色燈籠褲，在赤裸的腳踝處收攏。她身旁漂浮著一把長頸木製西塔琴，淡色的絲帶在肩頭飄動。寧靜而高雅，彷彿一首看得見的歌。

column1: A great stylised bird carved as if from smooth dark slate, sleek and totem-like rather than feathered. Its narrow head is topped by a rounded, helmet-like crest and holds two round, glowing orange-red eyes, with jagged lightning-bolt grooves running down its face like war paint. Two massive wings arch up from its shoulders and sweep down to long, curved points, their undersides ribbed with grooved black bands and edged in steely blue. Two small taloned hands cradle a red core at its chest, and below, its body spreads into a wide forked tail. It looks like a storm spirit of Native American legend, poised to crack the sky.
column2: 一隻巨大的風格化鳥，像是以光滑的深色板岩雕成，線條流暢，更像圖騰而非長了羽毛。窄窄的頭上有圓弧形、頭盔般的冠，嵌著兩隻圓圓的、發光的橙紅色眼睛，鋸齒狀的閃電溝紋從臉上一路向下，像戰紋。兩片巨大的翅膀從肩上拱起，向下掠成長長彎曲的尖端，翅膀內側有刻著溝槽的黑色條紋，邊緣是鋼藍色。兩隻帶爪的小手捧著胸前一顆紅色核心，下方身體向外展開，成為寬闊的分叉尾。看起來像美洲原住民傳說中的風暴之靈，隨時準備劈開天空。

column1: A tall, gleaming angel built like a golden statue: his skin is polished gold, his face calm and mask-like with bright blue eyes, under a silver helmet cut in a sharp, straight-fringed bob. A long, sleeveless emerald-green tabard bearing a big red cross hangs from his shoulders to his ankles, cinched with a knotted red sash whose long tails trail far behind. Silver and gold armour plates with round sun-wheel medallions sit at his shoulders, elbows and knees. From his back rises a golden horseshoe arch, and behind it spread vast wings of long, pale silver blades, layered like a feathered fan. Lofty and immaculate, a guardian of heaven.
column2: 一位高大、閃閃發亮的天使，彷彿金色的雕像：皮膚是打磨過的金色，面容平靜，像戴著面具，藍色眼睛明亮，頭戴銀盔，造型是一道利落、瀏海平整的鮑伯頭。他肩上垂下一件長長的無袖翠綠色外袍，直到腳踝，前面有一個大大的紅色十字，腰間繫著打結的紅色腰帶，長長的帶尾拖在身後很遠。肩膀、手肘和膝蓋處是銀金相間的甲片，上面有圓形太陽輪徽章。背後升起一道金色馬蹄形拱門，後方展開龐大的翅膀，由長長的淡銀色刀刃層層疊成，像一把羽毛扇。崇高、一塵不染，是天界的守護者。

column1: A lanky little imp whose head is a polished black and silver crescent moon: the thick curve of the moon forms his skull and chin, with pointed grey elf ears jutting from the sides, narrow, smug amber eyes, a black triangle of a nose and a thin, sly grin. His skinny body is clad in a snug dark red bodysuit with silver rings at the wrists and ankles, ending in curly-toed red slippers. In one hand he hauls a fat, lumpy burlap sack, stitched shut and banded in black, stuffed with the sand of sleep. Mischievous and a bit sneaky, the bringer of drowsy dreams.
column2: 一個瘦長的小妖精，頭是一輪打磨過的黑銀色新月：月亮粗厚的弧線構成顱骨和下巴，兩側伸出尖尖的灰色精靈耳，眼睛狹長、得意，是琥珀色，鼻子是一個黑色三角，嘴角掛著細細的狡猾笑容。他瘦削的身體穿著貼身的暗紅色緊身衣，手腕和腳踝處有銀環，腳上是尖端捲曲的紅色拖鞋。他一手拖著一個鼓脹、凹凸不平的粗麻布袋，縫得緊緊的，以黑色帶子束住，裡面塞滿了睡眠之砂。頑皮、有點狡猾，是帶來昏沉夢境的使者。

column1: A tall, lean young warrior with orange-red skin, long, shaggy greenish-blond hair and calm blue eyes. His crimson spiked helmet and sleeveless tunic are covered in silver-studded diamond plates, over a high collar of black chain mail. Two black straps with silver rings cross his chest, and white laced bands tie at his wrists and below his knees above black laced slippers. A round shield with a pink rim and an embossed silver face rides on his back, a dagger in an orange sheath hangs at his belt and he carries a long blue-steel broadsword. Every inch the dragon-slaying hero of German legend.
column2: 一位高大精瘦的年輕戰士，有著橙紅色的皮膚、蓬亂的綠金色長髮和平靜的藍眼睛。他的深紅色尖頂頭盔和無袖外衣上覆滿鑲有銀釘的菱形甲片，下方是黑色鎖子甲的高領。兩條帶著銀環的黑色皮帶在胸前交叉，手腕和膝蓋下方以白色繫帶綁著，腳上是黑色繫帶鞋。背上揹著一面圓盾，盾緣粉紅，盾面浮雕著銀色的臉，腰間掛著橙色刀鞘的匕首，手中提著一把長長的藍鋼闊劍。完完全全是德國傳說中屠龍的英雄。

column1: A stocky guardian lion-dog of Okinawa, about the size of a pony, with a bright yellow body and stout legs ending in big paws with white claws. Its huge round head grins wide, baring rows of square white teeth, with round staring eyes ringed in red, bushy curled brows and pointed yellow ears. A thick teal-green mane and beard, carved into tight curls and fading to dark red at the tips, frames its face and rises to a tall pointed spike on its head, and more teal curls sprout at its elbows, hocks and its big swirling tail. Fierce-looking but a bit comical, a loyal rooftop protector.
column2: 一隻沖繩的守護獅犬，大小像一匹小馬，身體鮮黃，腿粗壯，腳掌巨大，爪子是白色。又大又圓的頭咧嘴大笑，露出一排排方方正正的白牙，圓圓的眼睛瞪著，周圍一圈紅色，眉毛蓬鬆捲曲，耳朵尖尖，是黃色。濃密的青綠色鬃毛和鬍鬚雕成緊密的捲曲，末端漸漸變成暗紅色，圍著臉龐，並在頭頂豎成一根高高的尖刺，手肘、後腿關節和那條大大捲曲的尾巴上也長著更多青綠色的捲毛。外表兇猛卻有點滑稽，是忠誠的屋頂守護者。

column1: A lean, muscular god with deep blue skin, four arms and long black hair, gathered in a topknot with a gold finial and a silver crescent moon. His forehead bears three pale stripes with a vertical third eye between them and gold rings hang from his ears. Dark prayer beads hang on his bare chest and a scaly teal serpent coils around his shoulders and waist. He wears a leopard-skin loincloth with fur trim and a long crimson sash, and carries a tall golden trident, a conch shell and a small hand drum. Calm, beautiful and terrible: the Hindu destroyer god.
column2: 一位精瘦、肌肉結實的神，皮膚深藍，有四隻手臂和黑色長髮，頭髮盤成髮髻，上面有金色頂飾和一彎銀色新月。額頭上有三道淺色條紋，中間夾著一隻直立的第三隻眼，耳朵上掛著金環。裸露的胸口掛著深色念珠，一條帶鱗的青綠色蛇纏繞在肩膀和腰間。他穿著豹皮腰布，鑲著毛邊，繫著一條長長的深紅色腰帶，手持一支高大的金色三叉戟、一枚海螺和一面小手鼓。平靜、美麗而可怕：印度教的毀滅之神。

column1: A spindly paper-doll warrior, all flat, sharp-cornered planes as if folded and cut from card. Its front is split straight down the middle, one half white, the other black, and its back is blood red and black, painted with a column of black kanji. A great black and white crescent rises like horns above a small skull-like face with dark eye holes and a fringe of jagged, tooth-like strips for a jaw. Angular shoulder plates, banded white forearms, a short pleated skirt of layered paper strips and long claw-like fingers finish it. Eerie and weightless, a summoned paper spirit of Japanese sorcery.
column2: 一名瘦長的紙偶戰士，全身都是平整、帶尖角的面，彷彿從紙板上摺出來剪下來的。正面從中間一分為二，一半白、一半黑，背面則是血紅與黑色，畫著一列黑色漢字。一彎巨大的黑白新月像犄角般升在一張小小的骷髏臉上方，臉上有深色的眼洞，下巴是一排鋸齒狀、像牙齒一樣的紙條。稜角分明的肩甲、有條帶的白色前臂、由層層紙條組成的短褶裙，還有長長如爪的手指，構成了完整的模樣。詭異而輕飄，是日本方術召喚出的紙之靈。

column1: A broad, imposing general in Chinese armour, one of the four Heavenly Kings. His face is a golden mask of a scowl, with heavy black brows and a thick curled black moustache, under a dark green helmet with gold bands, a gold flower boss and a red plume on top, and silver winged guards over his ears. His armour is dark green lamellar scales trimmed in gold, with snarling lion heads on the shoulders, a white sash knotted at the waist and teal under-robes, over white sleeves, gold gauntlets and green greaves with red straps. Stern, proud and unbudging, a temple guardian.
column2: 一位寬肩、威嚴的將軍，身穿中國式盔甲，是四大天王之一。臉是一張金色的怒容面具，濃黑的眉毛和一撮濃密捲曲的黑鬍子，頭戴深綠色的頭盔，有金色的帶子、一朵金色花形的盔頂飾和頂上的紅纓，耳側是銀色的翼形護片。盔甲是鑲著金邊的深綠色片甲，肩上有咆哮的獅頭，腰間繫著打結的白色腰帶，內穿青綠色長袍，外面是白色衣袖、金色護手和繫著紅帶的綠色脛甲。嚴肅、驕傲、毫不退讓，是廟宇的守護者。

column1: A round little snowman-like imp, but jet black: a big round head on a pudgy little body. His floppy jester's hood is deep purple, with two pointed cat-ear peaks, a long zigzag tail flopping behind and a yellow crescent emblem on the front. His face has slanted, angry red eyes and a huge grinning red mouth with two white fangs. A purple collar of jagged points sits at his neck, his arms are ragged black stumps, and a little forked tail pokes out. He stands in purple boots with yellow cuffs and curling pointed toes. Cute, but grumpy and up to no good: a cheerful snow sprite's evil twin.
column2: 一個圓滾滾的小妖精，像雪人，但通體漆黑：一顆大圓頭配著胖嘟嘟的小身體。他鬆垮的小丑風帽是深紫色，有兩個尖尖的貓耳形帽尖，一條長長的鋸齒形尾巴垂在後面，前面有一個黃色的新月徽記。他的臉上是斜斜的、憤怒的紅眼睛，和一張咧得大大的紅嘴，露出兩顆白色尖牙。脖子上是一圈鋸齒尖角的紫色領子，手臂是破爛的黑色殘肢，一條小小的分叉尾巴從後面冒出來。他穿著帶黃色翻邊、鞋頭捲起尖尖的紫色靴子。可愛，卻脾氣暴躁、不懷好意：是那個開朗雪精靈的邪惡雙胞胎。

column1: A great crimson vulture king with huge, wide-spread wings of dusky rose-red feathers and a thick ruff of grey-white plumes around his long neck. His hooked beak is tan, his eye a bright blue, and on his head sits a dark bronze helmet with a pointed domed top and two curved horns. From his head hang heavy golden pendants with pale gemstones, each ending in a ribbed crimson tassel. His body is lean and red, his legs end in scaly tan shins and sharp talons, and an extremely long, thin, segmented tan tail trails far behind. Noble and battle-hardened, the loyal bird hero of Indian epic.
column2: 一位深紅色的巨大禿鷲王，張開的巨大翅膀布滿暗玫瑰紅的羽毛，修長的脖子周圍有一圈濃密的灰白色羽毛領。鉤狀的喙是黃褐色，眼睛是明亮的藍色，頭上戴著一頂深青銅色的頭盔，頂部是尖尖的圓頂，兩側各有一支彎角。頭上垂下沉重的金色墜飾，鑲著淡色寶石，每一條末端都綴著帶肋紋的深紅色流蘇。身體精瘦，是紅色的，腿部是帶鱗的黃褐色脛骨和銳利的爪子，一條極長、細細、分節的黃褐色尾巴在身後遠遠拖曳。高貴、身經百戰，是印度史詩中忠心的鳥英雄。

column1: A small, round snow sprite, about knee high, with snowy white skin, a big round head and a pudgy belly. He wears a floppy royal-blue jester's hood with two pointed cat-ear peaks, a long zigzag tail flopping behind and a yellow oval emblem on the front. His face is all happy cartoon: big black oval eyes and a huge open grin with two little white fangs. A spiky blue collar rings his neck, his white arms end in soft mitten hands, a tiny pointed tail pokes out behind, and he stands in chunky blue boots with yellow cuffs. Irrepressibly cheerful, the cutest little frost imp around.
column2: 一個圓圓的小雪精靈，大約到膝蓋高，皮膚雪白，頭又大又圓，肚子胖嘟嘟的。他戴著一頂鬆垮的寶藍色小丑風帽，有兩個尖尖的貓耳形帽尖，一條長長的鋸齒形尾巴垂在後面，前面有一個黃色的橢圓徽記。臉完全是快樂的卡通風格：大大的黑色橢圓眼睛，和一張大大咧開的笑嘴，露出兩顆小小的白色尖牙。脖子上圍著一圈藍色的尖刺領子，白色的手臂末端是柔軟的連指手套般的手，一條小小的尖尾巴從後面冒出來，他穿著帶黃色翻邊、厚實的藍色靴子。永遠開朗，是周圍最可愛的小冰霜妖精。

column1: A cheeky pumpkin-headed spook: a round orange pumpkin head with a carved face, two sharp glowing red-white eyes, a little triangle nose and a jagged, toothy grin. A floppy teal witch's hat with a white band and a long bent tip crowns him. Instead of a body there is just a billowing dark blue cloak, tied at the neck with a cord ending in two white pom-poms, flapping open over empty space. One white-gloved hand pokes out to hold an old iron lantern with a glowing yellow glass. Mischievous and impish, a Halloween trickster out for a night of pranks.
column2: 一個頑皮的南瓜頭幽靈：一顆圓圓的橙色南瓜頭，雕出的臉上有兩隻閃著紅白光的尖銳眼睛、一個小小的三角形鼻子和一排鋸齒狀、露著牙的笑容。頭上戴著一頂鬆垮的青綠色女巫帽，繫著白色帽帶，長長的帽尖彎折。他沒有身體，只有一件鼓盪的深藍色斗篷，脖子處以末端有兩顆白色絨球的繩子繫著，在空蕩蕩的空氣中敞開飄動。一隻戴著白手套的手伸出來，提著一盞舊鐵燈籠，黃色的玻璃發著光。頑皮、淘氣，是萬聖節的搗蛋鬼，準備整夜惡作劇。

column1: A towering, six-armed war god with bright green skin, a bull's long black horns and a fanged, beastly snout with small blue eyes. A white helmet with a pink ridged crest and orange trim sits between the horns. A scalloped white and pink mantle spreads over his shoulders, and a long red quilted tabard bears a big yellow disc printed with a black Chinese character. His many hands carry a long spear, a red-tasselled halberd, a golden axe and a great gold gong trailing yellow ribbons, and on his back hangs a round shield painted with a snarling blue and pink face. Brutish and unstoppable, an ancient Chinese warlord.
column2: 一位高聳的六臂戰神，皮膚亮綠，頭上長著公牛般的黑色長角，口鼻像野獸般生著獠牙，小小的藍眼睛。兩隻角之間戴著白色頭盔，帶粉紅色的脊紋冠，鑲著橙色邊。肩上披著扇貝形的白粉相間披肩，一件紅色的長絎縫外袍上有一個大大的黃色圓盤，印著一個黑色漢字。他眾多的手中分別持著一支長矛、一把紅纓戟、一柄金斧和一面拖著黃色綢帶的大金鑼，背上掛著一面圓盾，畫著一張猙獰的藍粉色臉。粗野、勢不可擋，是中國古代的軍閥。

column1: A slender woman with pale mint-green skin, amber eyes and long, flowing green hair that drifts out behind her and ends in wavy, tendril-like strands like waterweed. A neat white kerchief covers her head and falls to her shoulders. She wears a long, full, off-the-shoulder gown of burnt orange, its fitted bodice laced down the front with curling black ironwork-like scrolls, its long sleeves trimmed with the same at the cuffs, and its wide skirt edged in dark grey trim. Quiet and gentle, she looks like the ghost of a faithful old house servant from Scottish folklore.
column2: 一位纖細的女子，膚色是淡薄荷綠，有琥珀色的眼睛和長長飄逸的綠色頭髮，髮絲在身後飄散，末端是波浪形、如水草般的細絲。一條整潔的白色頭巾包住頭部，垂到肩上。她穿著一件長長、蓬鬆、露肩的焦橙色長裙，合身的上身繫帶處是捲曲的黑色鐵藝般渦紋，長袖袖口也有同樣的裝飾，寬大的裙襬鑲著深灰色滾邊。安靜而溫和，看起來像蘇格蘭民間傳說中一位忠實老僕人的鬼魂。

column1: A pale, mysterious warrior woman almost lost inside an enormous black cloak that spreads into a vast cone around her. She wears a tall, flat-crowned black hat with a very wide, sharply pointed brim, banded with leather and silver crosses. Beneath it her skin is ghostly white, her eyes closed and her lips pink, with a red rose painted on one cheek. Rings of green and teal stripes circle her neck over a black banded bustier, a silver Celtic cross hangs at her bare midriff, and she wears black briefs and long striped black gloves. Cool, enigmatic and deadly, a shadow-queen of Celtic myth.
column2: 一位蒼白而神祕的女戰士，幾乎被一件巨大的黑斗篷淹沒，斗篷在她周圍展開成一個巨大的圓錐。她戴著一頂高高的平頂黑帽，帽簷極寬、尖角鋒利，纏著皮帶並綴有銀色十字。帽下的皮膚如幽靈般慘白，雙眼緊閉，嘴唇粉紅，一邊臉頰上畫著一朵紅玫瑰。脖子上圍著一圈圈綠色和青綠色的條紋，下面是黑色束帶式胸衣，光裸的腹部掛著一個銀色凱爾特十字，她穿著黑色內褲和帶條紋的黑色長手套。冷靜、神祕、致命，是凱爾特神話中的暗影女王。

column1: A tall, slender goddess with jet-black skin, glaring red eyes and red lips. Her silver-white hair sweeps straight up into two tall pointed plumes like horns. Huge golden, carved collar pieces stand up on her shoulders like crowns, and from them falls a vast cape, deep forest green on the inside and patterned outside in a bold gold and black chevron weave, spreading wide to the ground like a cloak of mountain bark. Under it her body is a sleek, featureless black silhouette. Cold, regal and austere, a winter huntress-goddess of the Norse north.
column2: 一位高挑纖細的女神，皮膚漆黑，眼睛是怒視的紅色，嘴唇也是紅的。銀白色的頭髮直直向上梳成兩根高高尖尖、如角般的羽飾。肩上豎著巨大的金色雕花領片，像王冠，從那裡垂下一件龐大的披風，內裡是深森林綠，外面是醒目的金黑人字形編紋，向下一直展開到地面，像山間樹皮做成的斗篷。披風下她的身體是一道光滑、沒有細節的黑色剪影。冷酷、威嚴、肅穆，是北歐北方的冬季女獵神。

column1: A glorious crimson phoenix with a long, slender neck and a fluffy pink breast. Its head wears a soft white crest and a spray of pink feathers, with a small golden beak and blue eyes. Its wings flare wide in deep scarlet, and behind them rises a huge fan of red tail feathers, each tipped with a gold and orange eye like a peacock's, among curling black thorny spikes. Five long streamers hang far below it, blue, white, black, red and gold, each ending in a feathered eye. Dazzling and fiery, the vermilion bird guarding the south.
column2: 一隻輝煌的深紅色鳳凰，脖子修長，胸前是蓬鬆的粉紅色羽毛。頭上有柔軟的白色冠羽和一束粉紅羽毛，有小小的金色喙和藍色眼睛。翅膀以深緋紅色展開，後方升起一大扇紅色尾羽，每根羽尖都有一隻金橙色的眼紋，像孔雀一樣，間雜著捲曲的黑色刺狀尖刺。五條長長的飄帶垂到下方很遠，分別是藍、白、黑、紅、金色，末端各有一隻羽毛眼紋。耀眼、熾烈，是鎮守南方的朱雀。

column1: A tall, wiry god with dusky purple skin sitting cross-legged in the air, his face hidden behind a long, straight curtain of silver-white hair. On his head stands a towering silver crown of twisted, branching spikes, like dead branches or frozen lightning. A heavy necklace of curved golden fangs with a turquoise pendant hangs on his bare, muscular chest, and a long, stiff cape falls behind him, dark charcoal speckled with blood red and swirled with faint storm patterns, edged in grey beads. In one hand he holds a long, black, saw-toothed sword. Brooding and wild, the Shinto storm god in a moment of dangerous calm.
column2: 一位高大精瘦的神，皮膚是暗紫色，盤腿坐在空中，臉隱在一道長長筆直、如簾子般的銀白色頭髮後面。頭上聳立著一頂高大的銀冠，由扭曲、分岔的尖刺組成，像枯枝或凍結的閃電。赤裸、肌肉結實的胸口掛著一條沉重的彎曲金牙項鍊，墜著一枚綠松石，背後垂著一件又長又硬的披風，是暗炭灰色，上面點綴著血紅色，繪著淡淡的風暴漩渦，邊緣綴著灰色珠子。他一手握著一把長長的黑色鋸齒劍。陰鬱而狂野，是神道教的風暴之神，處在一瞬危險的平靜之中。

column1: A lumpy mound of oozing green sludge, roughly as tall as a person's waist, slumping and dripping in thick ridges down to the floor. Its slick surface is mottled with blotches of sickly yellow, densest on its rounded top, and pitted with dark little holes. Two round, glossy red eyes bulge from deep sockets, and below them gapes a wide, droopy black mouth with a heavy hanging lower lip. No arms, legs or clothes, just quivering muck. Gross, gloomy and a bit pathetic, the lowliest of creatures.
column2: 一堆凹凸不平的、滲著綠色淤泥的土丘，大約到人的腰那麼高，一道道粗厚的脊紋癱軟滴垂到地面。濕滑的表面布滿病態黃色的斑塊，頂部最密，上面還有深色的小坑洞。兩隻圓圓、光亮的紅眼睛從深陷的眼窩中鼓出來，下方是一張寬大、下垂的黑色嘴，下唇沉重地掛著。沒有手臂、腿或衣物，只有一團顫動的爛泥。噁心、憂鬱，有點可憐，是最卑微的生物。

column1: A towering, gaunt giant with charcoal-grey skin wrapped in irregular dark red bands like smouldering stripes of fire across his whole body. His head is long and tall, rising into a flat-topped cylinder like a fez, with narrow glowing yellow eyes, a heavy scowl, a hooked nose and a small stub of a beard on his chin. His body is lean but powerfully muscled, with long arms and bare feet. In one hand he grips a very long, thin, dark red sword with an orange and black patterned hilt. Grim and smouldering, the fire giant of Norse myth who will set the world ablaze.
column2: 一位高大、削瘦的巨人，炭灰色的皮膚上纏著不規則的暗紅色條帶，像全身布滿悶燒的火焰條紋。他的頭又長又高，頂部是平頂的圓筒，像一頂土耳其帽，眼睛是狹長發光的黃色，眉頭緊鎖，鼻子彎鉤，下巴有一小撮短鬍子。身體精瘦卻肌肉強健，手臂很長，赤著腳。他一手握著一把極長、極細、暗紅色的劍，劍柄有橙黑相間的花紋。陰沉而悶燒，是北歐神話中將讓世界陷入火海的火巨人。

column1: The monkey king of Chinese legend as a wiry old immortal sage, with a brown wrinkled ape face, pointed ears, a toothy grin, sharp blue eyes and a great white mane and beard. He wears a tall red scholar's hat banded in gold, a tasselled golden rod laid across its crown. He wears a sweeping crimson robe with enormous bell sleeves and orange-gold trim over a blue under-robe, cinched with a gold-buckled belt, He stands on a puffy white swirl of cloud, a long red staff capped in gold at both ends close by. Proud, mischievous and impossibly old, he looks like he still enjoys a good brawl.
column2: 中國傳說中的猴王，化作一位精瘦的老仙人，有著棕色布滿皺紋的猿臉、尖尖的耳朵、露齒的笑容、銳利的藍眼睛，以及一大片白色的鬃毛和鬍鬚。他戴著一頂高高的紅色學士帽，鑲著金邊，帽頂橫放著一根帶流蘇的金棒。他穿著飄逸的深紅色長袍，有巨大的鐘形衣袖，滾著橙金色的邊，內穿藍色內袍，繫著帶金扣的腰帶。他站在一朵蓬鬆的白色捲雲上，近旁是一根兩端包金的紅色長棍。驕傲、頑皮、老得不可思議，看起來仍然喜歡打一場痛快的架。

column1: A colossal Eastern dragon, the azure guardian of the east from Chinese lore, its body a tremendously long, thin serpent of dark navy-blue scales running far behind it, a row of yellow-green spines down its back and small clawed feet along its length. The head is all drama: a shaggy mane of dark green fur flaring like a lion's ruff, two branching tan antlers, long green whiskers trailing from the snout, blazing yellow-orange eyes under a scowling brow and a gaping red mouth of fangs. Its forelegs end in big hooked tan talons. It looks ancient, wise and furious, a storm of scales ready to coil around the sky.
column2: 一條巨大的東方龍，是中國傳說中鎮守東方的蒼龍，身體是一條極長極細的深藏青色鱗片的蛇，在身後一路延伸，背上有一排黃綠色的尖刺，身體全長各處都有帶爪的小腳。龍頭極為壯觀：濃密的深綠色毛髮像獅子的鬃毛般張開，兩支分岔的黃褐色鹿角，長長的綠色鬚鬚從口鼻拖下，眉頭緊皺，眼睛是熾烈的黃橙色，大口張開，露出紅色的獠牙嘴。前腿末端是巨大的黃褐色鉤爪。看起來古老、睿智又憤怒，是一場鱗片的風暴，準備盤繞整片天空。

column1: A young warrior hero of Irish legend, a boy with a neat black bowl cut and steady grey-blue eyes peeking over a long sky-blue tartan scarf, crossed with green and pink lines, wound up over his nose and hanging down his chest. He wears quilted white padded armour with puffed shoulders, a polished silver breastplate, a belt hung with two round carved wooden medallions and fringed tassels, blue tartan sleeves and short breeches, white quilted boots and a plain brown cape. He carries a long steel-tipped spear and a pair of slender wooden staves. Earnest, quiet and fearless, he looks like the hound of a hero in the making.
column2: 一位愛爾蘭傳說中的年輕戰士英雄，是個男孩，留著整齊的黑色碗型頭，堅定的灰藍色眼睛從一條天藍色格紋長圍巾上方露出，圍巾交錯著綠色和粉紅色的線條，繞過鼻子，垂在胸前。他穿著帶肩墊的白色絎縫軟甲、一件拋光的銀色胸甲、一條掛著兩枚圓形雕花木製徽章和流蘇的腰帶、藍色格紋的衣袖和短褲、白色絎縫靴，以及一件樸素的棕色披風。他帶著一支鋼尖的長矛和一對細長的木棍。認真、安靜、無畏，看起來是一位英雄的獵犬，正在成長。

column1: A huge, sleek black dragon, an Egyptian god of chaos and desert storms in monstrous form, its whole body dark charcoal with a faint purple sheen. Vast bat-like wings stretch far out to either side, their leading edges studded with small hooked claws. A long, narrow head bristles with a crown of backswept spikes, with small green eyes and a mouth lined with red. Its lean, muscular body stands on clawed hind legs, and a long whip of a tail trails behind it, ridged its whole length with jagged spines. It looks lithe, cruel and silent, a shadow of sandstorm and night given wings.
column2: 一條巨大、流線的黑龍，是埃及的混沌與沙漠風暴之神的怪物形態，整個身體是暗炭色，帶著淡淡的紫色光澤。龐大的蝙蝠狀翅膀向兩側遠遠伸展，翅膀前緣布滿小小的鉤爪。長而窄的頭上聳立著向後掠的尖刺冠，有小小的綠色眼睛，嘴邊鑲著紅色。精瘦、肌肉結實的身體站在帶爪的後腿上，一條鞭子般的長尾巴拖在後面，整條尾巴布滿鋸齒狀的尖刺。看起來矯健、殘酷、無聲，是長了翅膀的沙塵暴與夜的影子。

column1: A stern guardian king of Buddhist temples, a broad-shouldered warrior with green skin, a scowling, heavy-browed face with a thin drooping moustache and pale glaring eyes, his black hair tied up in a topknot under a small blue crown. He wears ornate armour in steel blue and charcoal: rounded black chest plates, blue shoulder guards moulded into snarling beast faces, gold-lined collar, layered black lamellar skirts, white sleeves and a thick white rope sash knotted at his waist, with blue leggings and black boots. Beside him stands a tall golden trident. He looks immovable and grim, a gatekeeper nothing slips past.
column2: 一位嚴厲的佛寺護法天王，肩膀寬闊的戰士，皮膚是綠色，皺著眉頭的臉上眉毛濃重，有一撮稀疏下垂的鬍子，眼睛蒼白而怒視，黑髮在一頂小小的藍色冠下綁成髮髻。他穿著華麗的鋼藍與炭灰色盔甲：圓形的黑色胸甲、塑成猙獰獸臉的藍色護肩、鑲金邊的領子、層層疊疊的黑色片甲裙、白色衣袖，以及腰間打結的粗白繩腰帶，還有藍色綁腿和黑靴。身旁立著一支高大的金色三叉戟。看起來巋然不動、陰沉，是一位任何東西都溜不過去的守門人。

column1: A silent, hooded figure set within a great wheel. A slender being with dark brown skin, a calm, mask-like face and faintly glowing red eyes peers out from a deep navy-blue hood, its long robe of glossy dark blue fabric falling in a layered cape over the shoulders and in wide sleeves to its bare feet. Around it stands a huge wheel of weathered grey stone, taller than a person, with six spokes meeting at a hub behind its back, and on the rim six round amber lamps glowing like eyes. It looks solemn and judging, an angel of the high ranks turned into the very wheel of fate.
column2: 一個戴著兜帽的沉默身影，立在一個巨大的輪子之中。一個纖細的存在，皮膚深棕色，面容平靜，像戴著面具，眼睛隱隱發著紅光，從深藏青色的兜帽裡向外窺視，長袍是光亮的深藍色布料，以層疊的披風形式垂在肩上，寬大的衣袖一直垂到赤腳。他周圍立著一個比人還高的巨大風化灰石輪，六根輪輻在他背後交會於輪轂，輪緣上有六盞圓形的琥珀色燈，像眼睛般發亮。看起來肅穆而審判著一切，是高階天使，化為命運之輪本身。

column1: A slender, golden-skinned goddess of fierce Hindu lore, with dark hair in a bun, red-lidded eyes painted with blue stripes beneath and a red mark on her brow. Her crown is a golden fan of finned plates topped with a ring of small skulls and gilded finials, and great golden disc earrings hang beside her face. She wears a cropped green top with silvery wave patterns, a dusky pink wrap skirt, and strand upon strand of red beads at her throat, arms, wrists, ankles and hips. She holds a pair of curved silver swords. Lithe and lovely in a deadly way, her beauty comes with a blade and a grin.
column2: 一位纖細、金色皮膚的女神，出自兇猛的印度教傳說，黑髮盤成髮髻，紅色眼瞼下畫著藍色條紋，眉心有一個紅色標記。她的冠冕是一把金色扇形，由帶鰭的甲片組成，頂端是一圈小骷髏和鍍金的頂飾，巨大的金色圓盤耳環垂在臉旁。她穿著露腹的綠色上衣，上有銀色波浪紋，暗粉色的圍裹裙，脖子、手臂、手腕、腳踝和腰間掛著一串又一串的紅色珠子。她手持一對彎曲的銀劍。矯健而可愛，帶著致命的味道，她的美麗附帶著一把刀和一抹笑。

column1: A seated skeletal monk, a mummified holy man of Japan who starved himself into a living Buddha, all bone and robes. A grinning bare skull peers out from under a tall, pointed golden-brown hat bound with a green band and two silver discs, long green streamers falling down beside the face. He sits cross-legged in a voluminous ochre-gold robe with great flaring sleeves, over a green under-robe crossed with a dark lattice pattern and edged in white. In his bony hands he holds a string of red prayer beads and a small golden ritual bell. Utterly calm and utterly dead, he radiates a creepy, unshakeable serenity.
column2: 一位坐著的骷髏僧人，日本的即身佛，是絕食修行成為活佛的木乃伊聖者，全是白骨與長袍。一個咧嘴笑著的光禿骷髏，從一頂高高尖尖的金棕色帽子下向外窺視，帽子繫著綠色帶子和兩枚銀色圓盤，長長的綠色飄帶垂在臉旁。他盤腿坐著，穿著寬大的赭金色長袍，袖子寬闊展開，內穿綠色內袍，上有深色格紋，邊緣是白色。骨瘦如柴的雙手握著一串紅色念珠和一個小小的金色法鈴。完全平靜，也完全死去，散發著令人毛骨悚然、不可動搖的安詳。

column1: A proud young thunder god of Japanese myth, with reddish-brown skin and narrowed amber eyes, his black hair looped into two bunches at his ears in ancient style and tied with a blue headband. Teal comma-shaped jewels dangle from his ears and hang on a necklace of dark beads at his chest. He wears a plain white tunic fastened with small ties and full white trousers bound below the knee with blue cords, with blue shoes. At his waist hangs a gold and blue apron panel marked with two rings, and a long black scabbard; a gleaming golden sword lies close by. He looks cool, confident and quietly dangerous.
column2: 一位驕傲的年輕雷神，出自日本神話，皮膚紅棕色，眼睛瞇起，是琥珀色，黑髮依古代樣式在耳邊綁成兩個髮束，繫著藍色髮帶。耳朵上垂著青綠色的勾玉，胸前一條深色珠子項鍊上也掛著勾玉。他穿著簡樸的白色上衣，以小繩繫住，下身是寬鬆的白褲，膝下以藍色繩子綁住，穿著藍鞋。腰間掛著一片金藍相間的圍裙狀飾板，上面有兩個圓環，還有一把長長的黑色刀鞘，一把閃亮的金劍就放在旁邊。看起來冷靜、自信、暗藏危險。

column1: A beaten, bound war god of Japanese myth, a hulking figure with green skin, a craggy ogre's face, small tusks and one glowing red eye, two pale curved horns sweeping from his temples and black hair tied in loops at the sides. He has no arms: dark round guards cap his shoulders, and thick hemp rope lashes his chest in a tight crisscross harness. He wears a white tunic and trousers, a navy sash with a dark stripe, red cords below the knee, dark shin guards and bare green feet. Defeated but still glowering, he looks like a captive who has not stopped plotting his revenge.
column2: 一位被打敗、被綁住的日本戰神，身形魁梧，皮膚是綠色，有崎嶇的鬼臉、小小的獠牙和一隻發著紅光的眼睛，兩支淡色的彎角從太陽穴向外掠出，黑髮在兩側綁成圈。他沒有手臂：深色的圓形護肩罩在肩膀上，粗麻繩以緊密的交叉捆綁在胸前。他穿著白色上衣和褲子、一條帶深色條紋的藏青腰帶、膝下的紅繩、深色脛甲和綠色的赤腳。雖然戰敗，仍然怒目而視，看起來像一個從未停止謀劃復仇的俘虜。

column1: A handsome elfin knight of Scottish ballad, tall and slim, with long straight silver-white hair framing a pale, fine-boned face and cool blue eyes, a teal circlet set with a diamond-shaped gem on his brow and a small ring in one pointed ear. He wears sleek teal plate armour edged in silver piping, with a high stand-up collar, flared shoulder guards and tall teal and black boots, over a black mail skirt, with black clawed gauntlets. A long white cloak with a grey lining hangs to his heels, and he carries a thin black spear. Elegant, melancholy and a little enchanted, he looks like a prince stolen away by fairies.
column2: 一位英俊的精靈騎士，出自蘇格蘭民謠，高挑纖瘦，長長的銀白色直髮框著蒼白、骨骼纖細的臉和冷冷的藍眼睛，額頭戴著一枚青綠色的頭環，鑲著菱形寶石，一隻尖耳上有一個小環。他穿著光滑的青綠色板甲，鑲著銀色滾邊，有高高的立領、外翻的護肩和高高的青綠黑色靴子，下方是黑色鎖子裙和帶爪的黑色護手。一件長長的白色斗篷，灰色襯裡，垂到腳跟，他提著一支細長的黑色長矛。優雅、憂鬱，帶著一絲魔力，看起來像一位被妖精拐走的王子。

column1: A tall, gaunt black god of darkness from Slavic myth, its body a single long column of glossy black robe flaring to the ground, with a red sunburst emblem glowing on the chest. Its face is a pale blue skull grinning under an enormous flat, round purple hat like a mushroom cap, its underside ribbed with gills. One hand grips a long, straight silver sword with a jewelled crossguard. Around the hem of its robe sprout slender teal stalks topped with little purple caps, a sinister garden of fungus. It looks patient, chilling and funereal, a lord of the night waiting for everything to rot.
column2: 一位高大、瘦削的黑色黑暗之神，出自斯拉夫神話，身體是一整條又長又光亮的黑色長袍，向下展開到地面，胸前有一個發光的紅色旭日徽記。臉是一個淡藍色的骷髏，咧嘴笑著，頭上戴著一頂巨大扁平的圓形紫色帽子，像蘑菇傘，帽底有一道道菌褶。一隻手握著一把長長筆直的銀劍，有鑲著寶石的護手。長袍的下襬周圍長出細細的青綠色莖，頂端是小小的紫色菌帽，是一座邪惡的菌類花園。看起來耐心、冰冷、有如喪禮，是等待一切腐朽的夜之主。

column1: A lithe, flamboyant god of wine and revelry from Greek myth, covered from head to toe in a psychedelic pattern of swirling waves in green, blue, yellow, orange and teal that runs right over his face like a painted mask. A shock of spiky silver-white hair crowns his head over long, wavy brown locks. A long crimson cloth drapes over one shoulder and spills far below his feet, and he wears white gloves and white boots. Slung on a cord he carries a twisted wooden staff topped with a silver pine cone. Wild, sensual and gleefully unhinged, he looks like a party that never ends.
column2: 一位矯健、張揚的酒與狂歡之神，出自希臘神話，從頭到腳覆滿迷幻的圖案，由綠、藍、黃、橙和青綠色的漩渦波浪組成，連臉上都布滿，像一張彩繪面具。一頭尖尖的銀白色頭髮立在長長的波浪棕髮之上。一條長長的深紅色布披在一側肩上，一直垂到腳下很遠，他戴著白手套，穿著白靴。他用繩子斜揹著一根扭曲的木杖，頂端是銀色的松果。狂野、感官、開心得瘋狂，看起來像一場永不散場的派對。

column1: A graceful fairy queen of English folklore, a slender woman with long, wavy golden hair falling to her waist, a pink lily tucked behind one pointed ear, teal eyes and soft pink lips. A green choker circles her throat. Her gown is a flowing forest-green dress with a scoop neckline, a pointed shoulder capelet and long sleeves, the full skirt patterned with golden zigzag flames and runes, and she goes barefoot with a thin anklet. From her back rise four tall, translucent wings of pale lilac and blue, veined like a dragonfly's. Regal, lovely and a little aloof, she looks every bit the queen of a moonlit forest court.
column2: 一位優雅的仙后，出自英格蘭民間傳說，一位纖細的女子，金色波浪長髮垂到腰間，一隻尖耳後別著一朵粉紅色的百合，眼睛青綠，嘴唇柔粉。頸間是一條綠色的頸圈。她的長裙是流動的森林綠，圓領，尖角的肩部短披肩，長袖，寬大的裙襬上繡著金色鋸齒狀的火焰與符文，她赤著腳，戴著細細的腳鍊。背後升起四片高高的半透明翅膀，是淡紫與藍色，像蜻蜓般布滿翅脈。高貴、可愛，略帶疏離，她完全就是月光森林宮廷的女王。

column1: A five-pointed star with a single great eye in its middle, a demon of old grimoires that hides in the shape of a star. Its front is a mottled rusty orange-red, smooth and slightly rounded, and its back is cold, blue-grey marbled stone with ridges running down each point. At the centre stares a large violet eye with a white gleam, ringed in black and fringed with short black tendril-like lashes ending in little dots. It is about the size of a person and almost flat. Odd, unblinking and creepily watchful, it looks like a starfish that has learned to cast spells.
column2: 一顆五角星，中間有一隻巨大的眼睛，是古老魔法書中的惡魔，藏身於星星的形狀之中。正面是斑駁的鏽橙紅色，光滑且微微隆起，背面是冰冷的藍灰色大理石，每個角上都有脊紋。中央凝視著一隻大大的紫羅蘭色眼睛，帶著白色的光澤，外圈是黑色，邊緣是短短的黑色觸鬚般的睫毛，末端是小小的圓點。大約和人一樣大，幾乎是扁平的。古怪、不眨眼、令人毛骨悚然地警戒著，看起來像一隻學會了施法的海星。

column1: An Egyptian baboon god of wisdom, perched on a giant closed book. He has a black, long-muzzled face with yellow eyes and bared teeth, framed by a huge thick ruff of white fur that rises around his head like a hood, and on his crown sits a golden disc resting in a golden crescent moon. Across his shoulders lies a broad Egyptian collar of teal and green with black panels dotted in gold diamonds. His body is lean and white-furred with black hands and a long thin tail. The book's tan cover bears hieroglyphs and a painted eye. He looks scholarly, smug and patient, a judge who has read everything.
column2: 一位埃及的狒狒智慧之神，坐在一本巨大的闔上的書上。他有黑色的長吻臉、黃色的眼睛和露出的牙齒，周圍是一圈巨大濃厚的白色毛領，像兜帽般升在頭周圍，頭頂是一枚金色圓盤，嵌在金色新月之中。肩膀上橫著一條寬闊的埃及式項圈，青綠色與綠色，黑色的區塊上點綴著金色菱形。身體精瘦，覆著白毛，雙手是黑色的，尾巴又長又細。書的黃褐色封面上有象形文字和一隻彩繪的眼睛。看起來博學、得意、耐心，是一位讀遍了一切的審判者。

column1: A towering, muscular thunder god of Norse myth, with deep brown skin, black knotwork tattoos banding his upper arms and thighs, and long black hair falling over his chest. His head is hidden in a gold helmet with a row of spikes along its crest and a closed faceplate, two glowing blue eye slits staring out. A gold breastplate of overlapping scales covers his torso above white briefs, and thick white banded cuffs wrap his forearms and shins. A white cloak and cowl drape his shoulders over a black lining. He wields a heavy, blocky grey hammer. He looks like pure power and swagger, a storm walking on two legs.
column2: 一位高大、肌肉結實的北歐雷神，皮膚深棕色，上臂和大腿上有黑色的結紋刺青，黑色長髮垂在胸前。他的頭藏在一頂金色頭盔裡，盔頂有一排尖刺，面罩緊閉，兩道發著藍光的眼縫向外凝視。一件由重疊鱗片組成的金色胸甲覆蓋著軀幹，下身是白色短褲，粗厚的白色條帶護腕和護脛包著前臂和小腿。一件白色的斗篷和兜帽披在肩上，襯裡是黑色。他揮舞著一把沉重、方塊狀的灰色錘子。看起來是純粹的力量與派頭，一場雙腿行走的風暴。

column1: A noble angel, pale, slender figure with long, wild dark blue hair and piercing green eyes. A long band of white parchment, marked with dark dots and dashes, curls behind his head and streams out to one side. Two broad wings of grey-brown feathers rise from his back. He wears a flowing white robe with a fine patterned hem, a red-jewelled silver belt, a brown sash and shoulder cape trimmed with gold key patterns, and a long crimson and brown cloak. In one hand he holds black balance scales, in the other a blue leather book. He looks serene, exacting and impartial, an angel of order.
column2: 一位高貴的天使，蒼白、纖細的身影，有著狂野的深藍色長髮和銳利的綠色眼睛。一條長長的白色羊皮紙帶，上面有深色的點和線，在他腦後捲曲，並向一側飄散。兩片寬闊的灰棕色羽翼從背後升起。他穿著飄逸的白色長袍，下襬有細緻的花紋，一條鑲著紅寶石的銀腰帶，一條棕色腰帶和肩披風，鑲著金色回紋，外面是一件長長的深紅與棕色斗篷。他一手持黑色天平，另一手拿著藍色皮革書。看起來寧靜、嚴謹、公正，是秩序的天使。

column1: A skeletal angel of the end of days, floating in long, rippling pale grey robes with no feet below. Its face is a grinning bone-white skull, framed by stiff golden curls rolled at each side like a judge's wig, under a tall black and gold checkered cap. A black stole runs down its chest, patterned with white clover marks and pointed triangles, and a long black bar rests across its shoulders. Great layered grey wings sweep down behind it. It carries a golden trumpet, topped by a small red bird ornament with one blue eye. Solemn and dreadful, it looks ready to sound the last call.
column2: 一位末日的骷髏天使，飄浮在長長、波動的淡灰色長袍中，下方沒有腳。臉是咧嘴笑著的骨白骷髏，兩側是僵硬的金色捲髮，像法官的假髮一樣捲起，戴著一頂高高的黑金棋盤格帽。一條黑色披肩從胸口垂下，上面有白色的三葉草記號和尖三角形，一根長長的黑色橫杆擱在肩上。層層疊疊的灰色大翅膀在身後向下展開。他持著一把金色號角，頂端是一隻小小的紅色鳥形飾物，有一隻藍眼睛。莊嚴而可怕，看起來準備吹響最後的號角。

column1: A serpent spirit of Hindu myth, a man above the waist and a snake below, with smooth pale blue-grey skin. His long black hair is tied in a topknot and falls in two long tails, beneath a silver scrolled tiara set with a small green gem. A bright yellow sash crosses his chest. His long scaly tail is pale blue in front and streaked with magenta along its back, a small bell tied to its tip with yellow ribbon. He carries a slim silver spear and a round steel shield bearing a coiled serpent emblem. Calm and watchful, he looks like a guardian of a hidden river temple.
column2: 一位印度神話中的蛇靈，腰以上是人，腰以下是蛇，皮膚光滑，是淡藍灰色。黑色長髮綁成髮髻，並垂下兩條長髮尾，頭戴銀色捲花髮冠，鑲著一顆小小的綠寶石。一條亮黃色的腰帶斜過胸前。長長帶鱗的尾巴正面是淡藍色，背面帶洋紅色的條紋，尾端以黃色絲帶繫著一枚小鈴。他帶著一支細長的銀矛和一面圓形鋼盾，盾上有盤繞的蛇形徽記。平靜、警覺，看起來像一座隱蔽河畔神廟的守護者。

column1: A king of the serpent people of Hindu myth, a man's torso rising from an immensely long snake's body, tan scales banded with dark red, stretching on and on behind him. His head is crowned by a great fan of golden spines like a cobra's hood, shading a cold, narrow face. A black spiked emblem marks his tan chest below a necklace of orange teeth, and his arms are clad in gold scales ending in golden claws. A sheer white stole loops around his shoulders and streams away. He wields a golden spear trailing a red tassel. He looks regal, cold and coiled to strike.
column2: 一位印度神話中的蛇族之王，人的軀幹從一條極長的蛇身上升起，黃褐色的鱗片帶著暗紅色的條帶，在身後一直延伸下去。他的頭上冠著一大片金色尖刺，像眼鏡蛇的頸盾，遮著一張冷漠、狹長的臉。橙色牙齒項鍊下，黃褐色胸口上有一個黑色尖刺的徽記，雙臂覆著金色鱗片，末端是金色的爪。一條透明的白色披肩繞過肩膀，向後飄散。他揮舞著一支金色長矛，拖著紅色流蘇。看起來高貴、冰冷，盤繞著隨時要出擊。

column1: A beautiful youth of Greek myth who loved his own face and became a flower, which grows right out of him: a cluster of white, bell-shaped daffodils on green stems sprouts from the crown of his head. He is slim and pale-skinned, with long, wavy golden hair spilling to his waist and falling over one blue eye. He wears nothing but a sash of deep crimson silk wrapped low around his hips, its long end floating out behind him. He stands in a tuft of bright green grass and more white daffodils. Dreamy, delicate and completely self-absorbed, he looks lost in his own reflection.
column2: 一位希臘神話中的美少年，愛上自己的面容，化為一朵花，花就直接從他身上長出來：一簇白色鐘形水仙，綠色的莖從他頭頂冒出。他纖瘦、皮膚白皙，金色的波浪長髮垂到腰間，並垂過一隻藍色的眼睛。他除了一條深紅色的絲綢腰帶低低圍在臀部之外，一絲不掛，腰帶的長端在背後飄蕩。他站在一叢亮綠色的草和更多白色水仙之中。夢幻、嬌弱，完全沉醉於自己，看起來迷失在自己的倒影裡。

column1: A monstrous serpent-worm of Norse myth, the dragon that gnaws at the roots of the world tree, its body an immensely long, smooth tube of pale teal hide veined with jagged violet lines, tapering to a needle-thin tail. It has no eyes at all: the front end is just a huge round gaping mouth crammed with big, blunt, eerily human-looking teeth around a pink tongue. Two short, stubby limbs with flat, finger-like flippers stick out near the head, a row of pale knobs runs along each flank and its underside is a dark ribbed red. Grotesque and hungry, it looks like an endless mouth that will chew through anything.
column2: 一條北歐神話中的巨蟲，啃咬世界樹根的龍，身體是極長、光滑的管狀淡青綠色外皮，布滿鋸齒狀的紫羅蘭色紋路，逐漸變細成針般的尾巴。牠完全沒有眼睛：前端只是一個巨大圓形、張開的嘴，擠滿了又大又鈍、怪異地像人類的牙齒，圍著一條粉紅色的舌頭。頭附近伸出兩隻短而粗的肢體，有扁平、像手指的鰭，兩側各有一排淡色的凸起，腹面是深色帶肋紋的紅色。怪誕而飢餓，看起來像一張無盡的嘴，什麼都能嚼碎。

column1: A smiling droplet of a gentle spirit from Shinto belief, the soul's peaceful side, shaped like a big, plump teardrop or comma-shaped jewel in smooth, glossy teal, its pointed tip curling up and over to one side like a curl of water. On its rounded front is a soft, simple face: happy closed eyes curved like crescents, a small rounded nose and a wide, contented smile showing a sliver of white teeth. It is about the size of a person's torso and has no limbs at all. Placid, cheerful and soothing, it looks like a little blob of pure good mood.
column2: 一滴微笑的水珠，是神道信仰中溫和的靈，是靈魂平和的一面，形狀像一顆大而飽滿的淚滴或逗號形寶玉，通體光滑發亮的青綠色，尖端向上彎過去，向一側捲起，像一圈水紋。圓潤的正面是一張柔和而簡單的臉：快樂閉著的眼睛彎成月牙，一個小小圓圓的鼻子，和一個寬寬滿足的微笑，露出一線白牙。大小約如人的軀幹，完全沒有四肢。平靜、開朗、令人舒心，看起來像一小團純粹的好心情。

column1: A pint-sized black cat warlord, a feline samurai general from Japanese legend, with big yellow-green eyes, a stubby snout and pink-lined pointed ears poking out from a black and gold helmet with a crescent moon crest and a flaming red plume. From his back rise two tall red war banners on gold-trimmed poles, one printed with a black paw print and one with a black cat's face. He wears pale teal lacquered armour edged with frilly white trim and gold, a small cat-face badge on the chest and a red cloth apron at the front, and carries a long black staff. He looks pompous, bossy and utterly adorable.
column2: 一位迷你的黑貓武將，日本傳說中的貓咪武士大將，有著大大的黃綠色眼睛、短短的口鼻，尖尖的耳朵內側是粉紅色，從一頂黑金色的頭盔裡冒出來，頭盔上有新月形的盔飾和火紅的羽纓。他背後豎著兩面高高的紅色戰旗，掛在鑲金邊的旗桿上，一面印著黑色肉球掌印，一面印著黑色的貓臉。他穿著淡青綠色的漆甲，鑲著蓬蓬的白色花邊和金邊，胸前有一枚小小的貓臉徽章，前面掛著一塊紅布圍裙，手持一根長長的黑杖。看起來自負、愛指揮人，又無比可愛。

column1: A slim, sly cat woman, a two-tailed demon cat of Japanese folklore given a human shape, with long, sleek brown hair, pointed black cat ears, slitted golden eyes and pale skin. A black mask covers her nose and mouth, striped with white whisker marks and showing two small fangs. She wears a skin-tight black bodysuit ribbed across the chest, hugging her lean, long-legged figure, under a cropped, shaggy jacket of white fur with dark cuffs, and her fingers end in black claws. A long, thin grey tail hangs behind her. Graceful, teasing and dangerous, she looks like a cat burglar who would happily scratch.
column2: 一位纖細、狡黠的貓女，是日本民間傳說中雙尾的妖貓化為人形，有著柔順的棕色長髮、尖尖的黑色貓耳、豎瞳的金色眼睛和白皙的皮膚。一張黑色面罩遮住鼻子和嘴，上面有白色的鬍鬚條紋，露出兩顆小尖牙。她穿著貼身的黑色緊身衣，胸前有肋紋，勾勒出她纖瘦的長腿身形，外面是一件短短蓬鬆的白色毛皮外套，帶深色袖口，手指末端是黑色的爪。一條細長的灰色尾巴垂在身後。優雅、愛逗弄人又危險，看起來像一個很樂意抓人的貓賊。

column1: A gaunt necromancer, a demon general of the grimoires who commands the dead, wrapped in a voluminous red hooded cloak that falls in a great diamond around a tall, thin body. His face is painted as a skull, white with purple shading, sunken red-rimmed eyes, and a gold chain earring hangs from one pointed ear. Beneath the cloak his purple skin is patterned in green, with red shorts, purple and white striped stockings. Beside him dangles a puppet skeleton of dark rods ringed in pale green and yellow, its head a cat-eared mask with green eyes and a red mouth. He looks theatrical, morbid and delighted with his toys.
column2: 一位憔悴的死靈法師，魔法書中統領亡者的惡魔將軍，裹在一件寬大的紅色兜帽斗篷裡，斗篷圍著他高瘦的身體垂成一個大菱形。他的臉畫成骷髏，白色帶紫色陰影，眼窩深陷，眼圈泛紅，一隻尖耳上掛著一條金鏈耳環。斗篷下他的紫色皮膚上有綠色花紋，穿著紅色短褲和紫白條紋的長襪。身旁垂著一具傀儡骷髏，由深色的杆子組成，圍著淡綠色和黃色的環，頭是一個貓耳面具，有綠色眼睛和紅色的嘴。看起來戲劇化、病態，對自己的玩具欣喜不已。

column1: A great golden wreath floating in the air: a thick ring of swirling, rippling gold like molten cloud, framing a perfectly round hole of pure black at its heart. Three winged women are sculpted into the ring as if grown from it, all in the same burnished gold. One sits on top, long hair streaming and a single great wing sweeping out behind her, while her two sisters cling to the sides, half sunk into the gold. Loose ribbons of gold curl and trail all around the rim. It looks like a holy relic, the three sisters of Norse fate keeping their watch over an empty void, serene and unknowable.
column2: 一個漂浮在空中的巨大金色花環：一圈厚厚的、旋轉波動的金色，像熔化的雲，框著正中間一個純黑的完美圓洞。三位有翼的女子被雕在環上，像從中長出來一樣，全是拋光的金色。一位坐在頂端，長髮飄揚，一隻大翅膀在身後展開，另外兩位姐妹攀在兩側，半沉入金中。鬆散的金色緞帶在邊緣周圍捲曲飄動。看起來像一件神聖的遺物，是北歐命運三女神守望著一個空虛的虛空，寧靜而不可知。

column1: A hulking, pot-bellied ogre with smooth blue skin veined with purple, red eyes, pointed ears and a fanged mouth gaping in a roar. A wild mane of black hair spills down his back under a tiger-striped headband, curved fang earrings hang from his ears, and a necklace of small skulls and fangs rings his thick neck. A tiger pelt is slung over one shoulder and wrapped around his huge gut, the beast's snarling, blue-eyed head riding on his shoulder, and tiger-striped cuffs bind his wrists and ankles. He carries a long black staff and a pale skull pierced with spikes. Brutish and greedy, a wild man who devours everything.
column2: 一個魁梧、大肚子的食人魔，皮膚光滑藍色，帶紫色血管，眼睛是紅色，耳朵尖尖，嘴巴張開咆哮，露出獠牙。一頭狂野的黑色鬃髮披在背上，繫著虎紋頭帶，彎曲的獠牙耳環垂在耳邊，粗壯的脖子上掛著一串小骷髏和獠牙的項鍊。一張虎皮搭在一邊肩膀上，圍著他巨大的肚子，猛獸猙獰、藍眼睛的頭伏在他的肩上，手腕和腳踝上綁著虎紋的護腕。他帶著一根長長的黑杖和一個插滿尖刺的淡色骷髏。粗野、貪婪，是一個吞噬一切的野人。

column1: A graceful Hindu goddess with pale skin, magenta eyes, painted pink lips, rose-pink hair in two round buns like flower buds, with a long tail down her back. A gold tiara set with a blue jewel crowns a small white cap, and a lavender veil sprinkled with gold falls from it over her shoulders. She wears gold earrings, a broad gold collar, a fitted pink top with gold-trimmed sleeves and a pink and gold sash, loose saffron trousers, and a long pink overskirt open at the front, dotted with tiny gold diamonds and hemmed in black and gold. She holds a little pink lotus. Serene, gentle and quietly regal.
column2: 一位優雅的印度教女神，皮膚白皙，眼睛是洋紅色，嘴唇塗成粉紅色，玫瑰粉色的頭髮盤成兩個圓圓的花苞髮髻，背後有一條長尾。一頂鑲著藍寶石的金色頭冠戴在一頂小小的白帽上，一條撒著金粉的薰衣草色面紗從頭冠垂過肩膀。她戴著金耳環、寬闊的金項圈，穿著合身的粉紅色上衣，袖子鑲金邊，繫著粉紅金色的腰帶，下身是寬鬆的藏紅花色長褲，外面是一條前面開口的長粉紅色罩裙，點綴著小小的金色菱形，下襬滾著黑金色的邊。她拿著一朵小小的粉紅蓮花。寧靜、溫柔，隱隱帶著皇家氣度。

column1: A slender grown-up fairy, taller and sharper than her little sisters, with a spiky crest of icy blue hair standing straight up, pale blue eyes, plum lips, pointed elfin ears and silver ring earrings. Her outfit is half armour: a polished grey steel breastplate riveted over a purple bodysuit, a steel collar at her throat, long purple gloves to the upper arm, dark charcoal leggings and chunky purple boots. From her back rise four tall, pointed insect wings, translucent and shimmering in turquoise, sea green and streaks of blue. She has the cool, haughty poise of a fairy queen's captain: pretty, but not to be trifled with.
column2: 一位纖細的成年妖精，比她的小妹妹們更高、更銳利，一撮冰藍色的頭髮尖尖地直立著，眼睛是淡藍色，嘴唇是梅紫色，有尖尖的精靈耳和銀環耳環。她的裝束一半是盔甲：拋光的灰色鋼製胸甲用鉚釘固定在紫色緊身衣上，喉嚨處有鋼製頸甲，長長的紫色手套直到上臂，穿著深炭灰色的緊身褲和厚重的紫色靴子。背後升起四片高高尖尖的昆蟲翅膀，半透明，閃著青綠、海綠和幾道藍色的光。她有妖精女王衛隊長那種冷靜傲慢的氣度：漂亮，但不容輕視。

column1: A winged Mesopotamian wind demon with a tall, lean, tan-furred body and the head of a snarling lion: blue eyes, pink-lined ears, bared teeth, and a shaggy mane and beard of silvery white. A crest of curved cream-and-gold plates fans over his skull like a helmet's comb, topped by a pale spike. A jagged stripe of rust-red feathers runs down his chest to his loins. Four great wings of tawny brown feathers spread from his back, two reaching high and two sweeping low, and his hands and bird-like feet end in dark hooked claws. Gaunt and ancient, he looks like a plague riding in on the desert wind.
column2: 一位有翼的美索不達米亞風魔，有著高大、精瘦、黃褐色毛皮的身體和一顆咆哮的獅頭：藍色眼睛，耳朵內側是粉紅色，露出牙齒，蓬亂的鬃毛和鬍鬚是銀白色。一圈由彎曲的米色與金色甲片組成的冠脊像頭盔的盔頂般展開在顱頂，頂端是一根淡色的尖刺。一道鋸齒狀的鏽紅色羽毛條紋從胸口一直延伸到胯部。四片黃褐色羽毛的大翅膀從背後展開，兩片高高伸起，兩片向下掠過，手和鳥一般的腳末端是深色的鉤爪。憔悴而古老，看起來像一場乘著沙漠風而來的瘟疫。

column1: A wiry monkey king of Hindu legend, with tawny fur, a long white beard and whiskers, fierce green eyes and an open, fanged mouth mid-roar. He wears a tall golden helmet shaped like a temple spire, a red jewel on its brow and pointed flaps flaring at the sides, and a broad golden collar of pointed wings studded with teal gems. Gold bands circle his arms, wrists and ankles. Below a red sash and gold medallion belt hangs a green apron worked with a golden swirl, flanked by long white streamers. He holds a gleaming scimitar, and a long tail hangs behind him. Old, proud and spoiling for a fight.
column2: 一位精瘦的印度傳說猴王，有著黃褐色的毛皮、長長的白鬍鬚與鬍鬚，兇猛的綠色眼睛，張著獠牙的嘴正在咆哮。他戴著一頂高高的金色頭盔，形如廟宇尖塔，額前有一顆紅寶石，兩側展開尖尖的護片，一條寬闊的金色項圈由尖尖的翼片組成，鑲著青綠色寶石。手臂、手腕和腳踝上有金色環。紅色腰帶和金色徽章腰帶下垂著一條綠色的圍裙，繡著金色漩渦，兩側是長長的白色飄帶。他握著一把閃亮的彎刀，一條長尾巴垂在身後。年老、驕傲，渴望一場打鬥。

column1: A sinister goat-headed idol with sooty black fur and skin, glowing red eyes in a long goat's face, and two pairs of great ridged horns curling back and out from its brow around a small pointed crest. A long, lank mane of black hair falls over its chest, partly hiding a woman's breasts capped in glossy black. At its belly sits a golden staff wound with twin serpents around a green orb. A white cloth wraps its hips, its shaggy legs are a goat's, ending in hooves, and two vast wings of dark brown-black feathers spread behind it. Half beast, half woman, wholly occult: a black-mass altar come to life.
column2: 一尊邪惡的羊頭偶像，毛皮和皮膚都是煤黑色，長長的羊臉上有發著紅光的眼睛，兩對巨大帶脊的角從眉間向後向外捲曲，圍著一個小小的尖冠。一頭長長下垂的黑髮落在胸前，半遮著一位女子的胸部，頂端是光亮的黑色。腹部有一根金色的權杖，雙蛇纏繞著一顆綠色寶珠。一塊白布包著臀部，毛茸茸的腿是羊腿，末端是蹄，兩片巨大的深棕黑色羽毛翅膀在身後展開。半獸半女，徹頭徹尾的神祕學：一座活過來的黑彌撒祭壇。

column1: A tall, ghostly woman wrapped in a long hooded robe of dusky rose-red, the hood rising to two small pointed peaks above her head. Her face is pale as porcelain, with blood-red eyes and red lips framed by dark hair. The robe clings to her slim figure before falling into enormous trailing sleeves and a ragged hem that drifts past her bare feet, slit at the front. With her goes a swaddled bundle of gold brocade, a baby wrapped tight in a hood and tied with a purple cord whose ends trail far below. A child-snatching demon turned protector of children, she looks both motherly and deeply unsettling.
column2: 一位高大、幽靈般的女子，裹在一件長長、帶兜帽的暗玫瑰紅長袍裡，兜帽升成頭上兩個小小的尖峰。臉像瓷一樣蒼白，有血紅色的眼睛和紅唇，被黑髮框著。長袍貼著她纖瘦的身形，然後垂成巨大拖地的衣袖和襤褸的下襬，飄過她赤裸的雙腳，前面開衩。她帶著一個包裹的襁褓，是金色錦緞，一個裹得緊緊的嬰兒，戴著兜帽，以紫色繩子繫著，繩端垂到下方很遠。搶走孩子的惡魔，如今成了孩子的保護者，她看起來既母性，又令人深深不安。

column1: A shaggy lion-beast of Balinese temple dance, long and low like a huge dog draped in a curtain of coarse cream-white hair that falls to the ground on every side, sturdy blue legs and paws peeking out beneath. Its face is a carved blue mask with bulging orange eyes, a black nose, square white teeth and pink ears, framed in an ornate silver headdress studded with blue gems, with a long beard of dark green strands and fringes of deep blue. Silver spikes crown its head, and its tail rises straight up as a tall silver pole topped with a spray of navy ribbons. Gaudy and kindly, a festival guardian.
column2: 一頭蓬鬆的獅獸，出自峇里島的廟宇舞蹈，又長又低，像一隻巨大的狗，披著一道粗糙的奶白色長毛簾，向四面垂到地上，結實的藍色腿和爪從下面露出來。臉是一張雕刻的藍色面具，眼睛是凸出的橙色，鼻子是黑的，牙齒方正潔白，耳朵粉紅，框在一頂鑲著藍寶石的華麗銀色頭飾裡，有一條深綠色細絲的長鬍子和深藍色的流蘇邊。銀色尖刺冠在頭頂，尾巴筆直升起，成為一根高高的銀色旗桿，頂端是一束藏青色緞帶。俗艷而和善，是節慶的守護者。

column1: An armoured angelic warrior with dusky violet skin, a shadowed face and piercing green eyes under a blood-red helmet that flares into two curling horns around a central spike. His red armour has a high ribbed collar, broad shoulder plates with gold rosettes, a moulded chest and plated gauntlets and shin guards, belted in brown leather over a red-and-black checked skirt and a long, pale grey-green tabard falling to his ankles. Two huge wings of dark slate-black feathers rise behind him. He carries a long red spear with a steel point and a kite shield of red edged in gold, emblazoned with a black octopus. A grim soldier of heaven.
column2: 一位披甲的天使戰士，皮膚是暗紫羅蘭色，臉在陰影中，眼睛是銳利的綠色，戴著一頂血紅色的頭盔，兩支捲曲的角圍著中間一根尖刺。他的紅色盔甲有高高的肋紋領子、帶金色玫瑰花飾的寬闊肩甲、塑形的胸甲，以及板甲護手和脛甲，繫著棕色皮帶，下身是紅黑格紋的裙子，外面是一件長長的淡灰綠色外袍，垂到腳踝。兩片巨大的深板岩黑羽翼在他身後升起。他拿著一支鋼尖的紅色長矛和一面鑲金邊的紅色鳶形盾，盾上有一隻黑色章魚紋章。一位冷峻的天界士兵。

column1: A tiny fairy with a bob of short auburn hair curling at her cheeks, big rose-pink eyes, a sweet little smile and pointed elfin ears. She wears a sleek high-necked royal blue leotard, long blue gloves and thigh-high blue boots, each topped with a black crisscross lacing band, with matching lacing on a black choker. Two pairs of wings sprout from her back, gauzy sky-blue and teal, marbled like water and curling at the tips into pale green tendrils. She looks bright, cheeky and eager, the plucky little sidekick fluttering at your shoulder.
column2: 一位小小的妖精，有一頭短短的赤褐色鮑伯頭，在臉頰處捲曲，大大的玫瑰粉色眼睛，甜甜的小微笑和尖尖的精靈耳。她穿著光滑、高領的寶藍色緊身衣，藍色長手套和藍色過膝長靴，每件頂端都有一圈黑色交叉繫帶，頸圈上也有同樣的繫帶。背後長出兩對翅膀，薄如紗，是天藍色與青綠色，像水一樣的大理石紋，尖端捲成淡綠色的卷鬚。看起來明亮、俏皮、熱心，是在你肩頭撲騰的勇敢小跟班。

column1: A gaunt, ghoulish figure with a starved, skeletal woman's frame and leathery rust-brown skin crossed with dark crack-like lines like dried bark. Its head is a nightmare: a smooth bulb from which a long, thin stalk juts out to each side, each tipped with a single yellow eye. Where the face and chest should be, a huge mouth splits the body open from throat to belly, lined in dark purple and studded along both edges with rows of curved ivory fangs. Its long arms end in spidery fingers with dark claws. Hollow and ravenous, a corpse-eating ghoul of Indian legend that seems to be nothing but hunger.
column2: 一個憔悴、如食屍鬼般的身影，有著飢餓的骷髏女人身形，革質的鏽棕色皮膚上布滿深色的裂紋，像乾枯的樹皮。牠的頭像個噩夢：一個光滑的球莖，兩側各伸出一根細長的莖，頂端各有一隻黃色的眼睛。本該是臉和胸的地方，一張巨大的嘴從喉嚨到腹部把身體撕開，內襯深紫色，兩側邊緣排列著一排排彎曲的象牙色尖牙。長長的手臂末端是蜘蛛般的手指，帶著深色的爪。空洞而貪婪，是印度傳說中的食屍鬼，彷彿只剩下飢餓。

column1: A stern Buddhist guardian god, broad and solid, with deep red skin, a furious scowl, heavy brows, gold eyes and a thick black moustache curling at the tips. His black hair is pulled into a topknot capped with a small gold crest. He wears ornate olive-gold armour: a high flared collar, a breastplate with round studs, shoulder guards shaped like snarling lion heads, a scaled skirt and plated shin guards, with white sleeves and a white sash knotted at his waist. In one hand he holds a small golden pagoda, in the other a short golden club. Unbending and thunderous, a divine general who guards the north.
column2: 一位嚴厲的佛教護法神，寬厚結實，皮膚深紅色，怒目而視，眉毛濃重，眼睛是金色，一撮濃黑的鬍子末端捲曲。黑髮盤成髮髻，頂著一個小小的金色冠飾。他穿著華麗的橄欖金色盔甲：高而外翻的領子、有圓釘的胸甲、塑成咆哮獅頭的護肩、鱗片裙和板甲脛甲，配著白色衣袖和腰間打結的白色腰帶。他一手持著一座小小的金色寶塔，另一手握著一根短短的金棒。剛直、如雷霆般，是鎮守北方的神將。

column1: A colossal white tiger, the guardian beast of the west in Chinese myth, its snowy fur striped in crisp black. Piercing ice-blue eyes glare from a broad face framed by a great ruff of white fur that sweeps back like flames from its cheeks and chest, and more flame-like tufts flare around its legs above heavy paws. Its mouth is open in a snarl, showing long fangs. A very long, thin striped tail stretches far behind it to a pointed tip. Powerful, regal and coldly furious, it prowls like winter itself.
column2: 一隻巨大的白虎，中國神話中鎮守西方的神獸，雪白的毛皮上有清晰的黑色條紋。銳利的冰藍色眼睛從寬闊的臉上怒視，臉周圍是一圈白色的毛領，從臉頰和胸口像火焰般向後掠去，腿上方、厚重的爪子周圍也有更多像火焰般的毛簇展開。牠張著嘴咆哮，露出長長的尖牙。一條極長極細、帶條紋的尾巴在身後遠遠伸展，末端尖尖。強大、尊貴、冷冷地憤怒，牠踱步如同冬天本身。

column1: A Roman goddess of luck with long wavy hair of deep royal blue, amber eyes and a knowing half-smile, a small white hood perched on the back of her head. A white high-necked halter top hugs her bust and leaves her shoulders and arms bare, and a silver spoked wheel, like a chariot's, is set right into her midriff. A short wrapped brown skirt, lined in dark red, sits at her hips over long bare legs. Two long scarves loop around her in great arcs, one twisted brown and one gauzy white, like a wheel forever turning. Capricious, she could smile on you or spin you down.
column2: 一位羅馬幸運女神，有著深寶藍色的波浪長髮、琥珀色的眼睛和意味深長的半笑，後腦勺上戴著一頂小小的白色兜帽。一件白色高領掛頸上衣貼著她的胸部，露出肩膀和手臂，一個銀色的輻條輪子，像戰車的輪子，嵌在她的腹部正中。一條短短的棕色圍裹裙，襯裡深紅色，繫在臀部，露出修長的光腿。兩條長圍巾在她周圍繞成大大的弧線，一條是扭絞的棕色，一條是輕薄的白色，像一個永不停止轉動的輪子。她反覆無常，可能對你微笑，也可能把你轉下去。

column1: A huge flat fish-demon, part manta ray and part shark, its body spreading into vast wide fins that sweep out far to either side, with a tall shark's dorsal fin and a long, whip-thin tail behind. Its hide is charcoal grey dappled with darker blue-black spots, with gill slits along the underside. A squat head rises from its back: a stony grey face with narrow teal eyes, curved black horns and a silver crown set with green gems. Below it, at the front edge of the body, two small purple eyes sit above a wide mouth of jagged teeth. A brooding king of the deep, gliding low and sly.
column2: 一條巨大扁平的魚形惡魔，一半是魔鬼魟，一半是鯊魚，身體展開成巨大寬闊的鰭，向兩側遠遠伸出，背上有一片高高的鯊魚背鰭，後面是一條鞭子般的細長尾巴。皮膚是炭灰色，點綴著較深的藍黑色斑點，腹面有鰓裂。一顆矮壯的頭從背上升起：一張石灰色的臉，有狹長的青綠色眼睛、彎曲的黑角和鑲著綠寶石的銀冠。下方，身體前緣處，兩隻小小的紫色眼睛位於一張滿是鋸齒狀牙齒的大嘴上方。一位沉思的深海之王，低低滑行，狡猾陰險。

column1: A lean, battle-hardened Japanese sword god with grey-green skin, glaring magenta eyes and a deep frown. Long straight hair of dark violet falls past his shoulders from under a white headband marked with a black-and-white yin-yang emblem, and a leather cord at his throat holds a curved purple jewel. Grey bandages wrap his arms, chest, waist and thighs, like a monk who trains until he bleeds, and the rest of him is bare and sinewy. Beside him stands a towering rack of swords, dozens of slim verdigris-green blades side by side like a fence. Austere and unshakeable, a swordsman's spirit who has given everything to the blade.
column2: 一位精瘦、身經百戰的日本劍神，皮膚灰綠色，眼睛是怒視的洋紅色，眉頭深鎖。深紫羅蘭色的長直髮從一條白色頭帶下垂過肩膀，頭帶上有黑白色的陰陽徽記，脖子上的皮繩掛著一枚彎曲的紫色寶玉。灰色的繃帶纏著他的手臂、胸口、腰部和大腿，像一位修行到流血的僧人，其餘部分裸露、筋肉結實。他身旁立著一座高聳的劍架，幾十把細長的銅綠色劍刃並排，像一道籬笆。嚴峻、堅定不移，是一位把一切都獻給了劍的劍士之靈。

column1: A demon leopard in the shape of a tall, lean man, its scarlet leopard's head set low on its chest, with ice-blue eyes, white jowls and fangs flanked by two gold tusks. Its body is red fur with black rosettes and a white belly. It wears a high-shouldered black leather jacket studded with small gold spikes, the collar rising behind it in two tall black columns, with gold-and-black striped bands at the shoulders. Between the columns rises a black-and-gold pillar topped by a tiny grinning blue demon face in a gold crest. Black gauntlets end in long golden claws. Flashy, menacing and feral.
column2: 一隻惡魔豹，形如一個高大瘦長的男人，鮮紅色的豹頭低低地長在胸口，有冰藍色的眼睛、白色的頰毛和獠牙，兩側各有一根金色長牙。身體是紅色皮毛帶黑色玫瑰斑紋，腹部是白色。他穿著高肩的黑色皮夾克，鑲著小小的金色尖釘，領子在身後升成兩根高高的黑色柱子，肩部有金黑條紋的帶子。兩根柱子之間升起一根黑金色的支柱，頂端是金色冠飾裡一張小小咧嘴笑的藍色惡魔臉。黑色護手末端是長長的金色爪。浮誇、威脅、野性。

column1: A noble angel in the look of a crusader prince, with pale skin, a calm, faintly sad face and golden eyes. A silver helmet sprouts a crown of long, sharp silver spikes like rays of light, ringed in gold, and a hood of chainmail falls to his shoulders under a short teal capelet. Over chainmail sleeves he wears a royal blue tunic and a green surcoat hung with gold medallions, over a long pale robe hemmed in yellow, with a sword at his hip. Two great wings of olive and green feathers rise behind him, and he holds a long staff crowned with a golden cross. Dignified and devout.
column2: 一位天使，樣子像十字軍王子，皮膚白皙，臉平靜而略帶悲傷，眼睛是金色。銀色頭盔上長出一圈長長尖銳的銀刺，像光芒，鑲著金邊，一頂鎖子甲兜帽垂到肩上，上面是一件短短的青綠色披肩。鎖子甲袖外穿著寶藍色外衣，罩著一件綴著金色徽章的綠色罩袍，下面是下襬黃色的淡色長袍，腰間佩劍。兩片橄欖色與綠色羽毛的大翅膀在背後升起，他持著一根長杖，頂端是金色十字架。莊嚴而虔誠。

column1: A hooded skeleton on a pale horse, the fourth horseman of the apocalypse. The rider's face is a bare, yellowed skull deep in a black hood, his black robe flowing into enormous ragged sleeves and a tattered hem that hangs over the horse's flanks, with bony gauntleted hands poking out. He carries a long scythe on a brown wooden shaft, its thin black blade sweeping in a cruel curve. His steed is ghostly grey-white, with pale blue eyes, a long, wispy mane falling over its face and a ragged, smoky tail, harnessed in black straps. Silent and inevitable, death itself come riding.
column2: 一具戴兜帽的骷髏，騎在一匹淡色的馬上，是天啟四騎士中的第四位。騎士的臉是一顆光禿、發黃的骷髏，藏在深深的黑色兜帽裡，黑袍流成巨大破爛的衣袖和襤褸的下襬，垂在馬的側腹上，骨瘦如柴的戴著護手的手從中伸出。他持著一把長長的鐮刀，棕色木柄，細細的黑色刀刃彎成殘酷的弧線。他的坐騎是幽靈般的灰白色，有淡藍色的眼睛，長長稀疏的鬃毛垂在臉上，一條破爛、如煙的尾巴，繫著黑色的皮帶。沉默而不可避免，是騎馬而來的死亡本身。

column1: A hulking giant of Greek myth with smooth, mottled teal skin and the muscles of a statue, sprouting a whole crown of arms: ten of them, fanning out from its shoulders and back in every direction. Its head is a lumpy dome scattered with round, glassy blue eyes, and three gaping mouths full of big human teeth open on its face and sides. The main mouth is gagged: a gold chain runs straight through it and a heavy brass padlock is jammed between its teeth. Chained, many-handed and howling, it looks like a prisoner of the gods that never stopped struggling.
column2: 一位希臘神話中的魁梧巨人，皮膚光滑，是斑駁的青綠色，肌肉像雕像，長出一整圈手臂：十條，從肩膀和背部向四面八方展開。頭是一個凹凸不平的圓頂，散布著圓圓、玻璃般的藍色眼睛，臉上和兩側張著三張大嘴，滿是巨大的人類牙齒。主要的嘴被堵住了：一條金鏈直直穿過嘴巴，一把沉重的黃銅掛鎖卡在牙齒之間。被鎖鏈束縛、多手、嚎叫，看起來像神明的囚徒，從未停止掙扎。

column1: An armoured knight on a blood-red warhorse. The rider is encased head to toe in dark, slate-teal plate armour: a visored helmet topped with a spike and flared crests, golden eyes glinting through the slit, ridged shoulder plates, round elbow guards, flanged gauntlets and a layered plate skirt. He carries a long golden lance with a barbed point. His horse is muscular and deep red, with a thick black mane, a long black tail, gold hooves, a dark leather saddle and silver stirrups. Grim and martial, a demon duke of war riding out at the head of hell's cavalry.
column2: 一位披甲的騎士，騎在一匹血紅色的戰馬上。騎士從頭到腳裹在深板岩青綠色的板甲裡：帶面甲的頭盔，頂上有一根尖刺和外展的冠飾，金色的眼睛從縫隙中閃爍，肩甲有脊紋，肘甲是圓形的，護手帶凸緣，層層疊疊的板甲裙。他持著一支帶倒刺尖端的長金槍。他的馬肌肉結實，深紅色，有濃密的黑色鬃毛，一條長長的黑尾巴，金色的蹄子，深色皮鞍和銀色馬鐙。冷峻、尚武，是一位戰爭的惡魔公爵，率領地獄的騎兵出陣。

column1: A grinning skull in black leather astride a chopper. Its head is a bare, bone-white skull with fiery orange eyes, and a long red scarf at its throat streams out behind it like a flag. A black leather biker jacket with a wide collar and silver piping, black gloves, black trousers and knee-high black boots complete the look. The motorcycle is a long chrome chopper with towering handlebars, a stretched front fork, a round headlamp, an exposed engine and a pink fuel tank painted with a red heart and a yellow lightning bolt. A ghost rider of urban legend, loud, reckless and out for one last race.
column2: 一具咧嘴笑的骷髏，穿著黑色皮衣，騎在一輛改裝摩托上。頭是光禿禿骨白色的骷髏，眼睛是火橙色，喉嚨處一條長長的紅圍巾在身後飄蕩，像一面旗。一件黑色皮革騎士夾克，領子寬大，鑲著銀色滾邊，配上黑手套、黑長褲和及膝黑靴，完成了這身裝扮。摩托是一輛長長的鍍鉻改裝車，有高聳的把手、拉長的前叉、圓形的頭燈、外露的引擎和一個粉紅色的油箱，上面畫著紅色愛心和黃色閃電。都市傳說中的幽靈騎士，喧鬧、魯莽，要跑最後一場競速。

column1: A monstrous giant fly, its bloated, ribbed abdomen and hunched body covered in blue-black chitin edged with ragged spines. Huge glossy red compound eyes bulge beneath a gold helm striped in black like a tiger, its brim sweeping up into horns. A long, segmented rust-red proboscis hangs from its face between curved white mandibles, and a necklace of small grey skulls rings its throat. Its thorny, crooked legs end in hooked claws, and one clutches a bone sceptre tipped with a skull. Two tall wings shimmer from white to green and violet, each marked with a black skull and crossbones. The lord of flies, regal and filthy.
column2: 一隻巨大的怪蠅，膨脹、帶肋紋的腹部和駝著的身體覆著藍黑色的甲殼，邊緣是破碎的尖刺。巨大光亮的紅色複眼從一頂像老虎般帶黑色條紋的金色頭盔下鼓出來，帽簷向上掠成角。一根長長、分節的鏽紅色口器從臉上垂下，位於彎曲的白色上顎之間，脖子上掛著一串小小的灰色骷髏項鍊。帶刺、彎曲的腿末端是鉤爪，一隻抓著一根骨製權杖，頂端是骷髏。兩片高高的翅膀閃爍著從白到綠到紫的光澤，各印著一個黑色的骷髏與交叉腿骨。蒼蠅之王，高貴而骯髒。

column1: A squat, brawny demon with deep purple skin, tall ridged horns curving upward, pointed ears, a hooked nose and small red eyes under a heavy brow, a nasty grin full of jagged teeth and a scruffy grey beard. A black spiked collar sits at his throat. His hands and lower legs are tan, like old leather gloves and boots, ending in purple claws, and a thin purple tail tipped with an arrowhead trails behind him. His throne is a gleaming white porcelain toilet, lid raised, never far from his backside. Lazy, crude and gleefully vulgar, a demon of sloth who would rather sit than stand.
column2: 一個矮壯、結實的惡魔，皮膚深紫色，高高帶脊的角向上彎，耳朵尖尖，鷹鉤鼻，粗眉下是小小的紅眼睛，咧著滿是鋸齒狀牙齒的壞笑，一把雜亂的灰色鬍子。喉嚨處有一圈黑色帶尖刺的項圈。他的手和小腿是黃褐色，像舊皮手套和皮靴，末端是紫色的爪，一條細細的紫色尾巴末端是箭頭形，拖在身後。他的寶座是一個光亮的白色瓷馬桶，蓋子掀起，屁股從不離開。懶惰、粗魯、開心地低俗，是一個寧可坐著也不站起的怠惰惡魔。

column1: A magnificent phoenix of Chinese and Japanese legend, built like a long-legged pheasant. Its body is crimson, its throat and breast covered in a ruff of shaggy jade-green feathers fading to pale mint, and a spiky red crest frames its face around a small gold beak. From its crown rises a tall golden plume curled into spirals like flames. Its broad wings are slate blue on the front with bright red edges and solid red behind, and an extremely long, thin tail of olive-gold feathers streams far behind it. Golden scaled legs end in sharp talons. Radiant and auspicious, a bird of good fortune on the wing.
column2: 一隻華麗的鳳凰，出自中國與日本的傳說，形如一隻長腿的雉雞。身體是深紅色，喉嚨和胸前覆著一圈蓬亂的翡翠綠羽毛，逐漸變成淡薄荷色，一頂尖尖的紅色冠羽框著臉，圍著一隻小小的金色喙。頭頂升起一根高高的金色羽飾，捲成像火焰般的螺旋。寬闊的翅膀正面是板岩藍，帶亮紅色的邊緣，背面是純紅色，一條極長極細的橄欖金色羽毛尾巴在身後遠遠飄散。金色帶鱗的腿末端是銳利的爪。光輝而吉祥，是展翅飛翔的好運之鳥。

column1: A great golden falcon, the bird of an Egyptian sky god, every feather of its body, wings and long fanned tail shining gold, from deep amber to pale straw. Its head is fierce and compact, with a hooked pinkish beak and small, piercing blue eyes under a ruff of spiky golden feathers. Its wings are broad and pointed, and long tail plumes trail below. Its legs are clad in rust-red scales and end in big hooked talons of glossy black. Dazzling and proud, it looks like the midday sun given wings.
column2: 一隻巨大的金色獵鷹，是埃及天空之神的鳥，身體、翅膀和長長展開的尾巴的每一根羽毛都閃著金光，從深琥珀色到淡稻草色。頭部兇猛而緊湊，有鉤狀的粉紅色喙和小小的銳利藍眼睛，位於一圈尖尖的金色羽毛領之下。翅膀寬闊而尖，長長的尾羽垂在下方。腿覆著鏽紅色的鱗片，末端是巨大的鉤爪，為光亮的黑色。耀眼而驕傲，看起來像長了翅膀的正午太陽。

column1: A hooded skeletal horseman, a crowned rider of the apocalypse. Under a deep black hood grins a bare white skull, topped by a spiked gold crown. His long black robe has wide sleeves and hangs in tattered, ragged strips over his mount's flanks, a leather strap crossing his chest to a quiver of white-fletched arrows on his back, and he carries a long, slender wooden bow. He rides a pale white horse with a wild, shaggy straw-white mane and tail, its whole hide dotted with dozens of staring blue eyes. Silent, regal and deathly, he looks like conquest itself come riding.
column2: 一位戴兜帽的骷髏騎士，戴著王冠的天啟騎手。深黑色的兜帽下咧嘴笑著一顆光禿禿的白色骷髏，頭頂戴著一頂有尖刺的金冠。他的黑色長袍有寬大的衣袖，破爛襤褸的布條垂在坐騎的側腹上，一條皮帶斜過胸前，連到背後一個插著白羽箭的箭筒，他持著一把長長細細的木弓。他騎著一匹淡白色的馬，鬃毛和尾巴是狂野蓬亂的稻白色，整個皮毛上點綴著幾十隻瞪著的藍色眼睛。沉默、尊貴、死氣沉沉，看起來像是征服本身騎馬而來。

column1: A grotesque demon of lust, frankly and unmistakably phallic. Its towering green body is a ribbed, veined shaft capped with a smooth domed head, beneath which gapes a wide, wet pink mouth with a lolling tongue. Long tapering green spines fan out from its back, and small clawed limbs wave from its sides. It rides a gleaming brass war chariot carved with a grinning skull, with big spoked wheels, coiled springs and curved silver blades jutting from the front. Lewd, leering and absurdly proud of itself, it's as obscene as it is menacing.
column2: 一個怪誕的色慾惡魔，直白而毫不含糊地呈現陽具形態。它高聳的綠色身體是一根帶肋紋、布滿血管的柱體，頂著光滑的圓頂，下方張著一張寬大濕潤的粉紅色嘴，舌頭懶懶垂著。長長漸細的綠色尖刺從背後扇形展開，小小帶爪的肢體從兩側揮動。它乘著一輛閃亮的黃銅戰車，車上雕著一個咧嘴笑的骷髏，有大大的輻條輪、盤繞的彈簧，前面伸出彎曲的銀色刀刃。淫蕩、色瞇瞇，荒謬地為自己驕傲，既猥褻又帶威脅。

column1: A skeletal temptress riding a seven-headed beast. The woman wears a long blood-red veil framing a bare white skull, a gold-banded headdress studded in black, a beaded necklace with a round gold pendant, and a low-cut red top with puffed sleeves showing pale cleavage, over billowing purple striped bloomers and long purple gloves; one hand raises a golden goblet. Beneath her prowls a huge red beast with seven snarling horned heads, each wearing a little spiked gold crown, its hide spotted with black diamonds, with bat-like red wings and a long spiny tail. Decadent, seductive and rotten to the bone.
column2: 一位骷髏誘惑者，騎著一頭七頭獸。女子戴著一條長長的血紅色面紗，框著光禿的白色骷髏，頭飾有金色帶子，鑲著黑色，一條串珠項鍊掛著圓形金墜子，穿著低胸的紅色上衣，泡泡袖，露出蒼白的乳溝，下身是寬鬆的紫色條紋燈籠褲，戴著紫色長手套；一隻手舉起金色高腳杯。她身下蹲伏著一頭巨大的紅色野獸，有七顆咆哮、長角的頭，每顆都戴著一頂小小有尖刺的金冠，皮毛上點綴著黑色菱形，有蝙蝠般的紅色翅膀和一條長長帶刺的尾巴。頹廢、誘惑，爛到骨子裡。

column1: A vengeful samurai lord of Japanese legend, wild and imperious. A huge, windswept mane of deep blue hair falls over a stark white face painted kabuki-style with bold red streaks around glaring yellow eyes, set in a fierce scowl. He wears flowing robes of burnished gold patterned with thin circles, with broad, stiff shoulders over full white sleeves and wide gold trousers, and a white panel at his waist bears a black crest of small circles ringed around a central one. A long sword in a brown lacquered scabbard hangs at his waist. He looks like a furious ghost-general, proud and unforgiving.
column2: 一位日本傳說中復仇的武士領主，狂野而傲慢。一大片被風吹亂的深藍色鬃髮垂在慘白的臉上，臉上以歌舞伎風格畫著粗粗的紅色線條，環繞著怒視的黃色眼睛，面帶兇狠的怒容。他穿著飄逸的拋光金色長袍，上有細圓圈圖案，寬闊僵挺的肩部下是寬大的白色衣袖和寬寬的金色長褲，腰間的白色飾板上有黑色家紋，是一圈小圓圍著中間一個圓。一把長刀，棕色漆鞘，掛在腰間。看起來像一位憤怒的亡魂將軍，驕傲而不寬恕。

column1: A towering four-armed demon of intoxication in bold, clownish colours. Its tall, narrow purple head is a mask-like dome patterned with rows of orange flame strokes, with a grimacing set of square teeth near the bottom and fat turquoise curls like tusks and whiskers around it. Its stocky body and limbs are black, dotted with white spots and ringed with white stripes, with clawed purple hands, turquoise cuffs and discs at the wrists and a flaring turquoise skirt-like frill at the waist. Behind it stands a great turquoise wheel with eight spokes. Bloated, grinning and drunkenly menacing.
column2: 一個高聳的四臂陶醉惡魔，色彩鮮豔、像小丑。它高高窄窄的紫色頭像面具般的圓頂，上面有一排排橙色火焰筆觸，靠下方有一排扭曲的方形牙齒，周圍是肥大的青綠色捲曲，像獠牙和鬍鬚。它矮壯的身體和四肢是黑色的，點綴著白色斑點，圍著白色條紋，有帶爪的紫色手，手腕處有青綠色的袖口和圓盤，腰間是一圈展開的青綠色裙狀飾邊。它身後立著一個巨大的青綠色八輻輪。臃腫、咧嘴笑著、醉醺醺地威脅。

column1: A skeleton bullfighter, all flourish and swagger. A grinning white skull peers out from under a teal tricorn hat trimmed with gold braid. He wears a matador's suit of lights: a short teal jacket heavy with gold embroidery, rows of gold ornaments set with red jewels across the front and big gold-encrusted shoulder pads, a white cravat pinned with a red gem, a red sash, tight white trousers striped with gold, and tall teal boots. One bony hand holds a long, thin curved sword with a gold cup guard, the other a red cape hung from a rod. Long dead, but still dancing with danger.
column2: 一位骷髏鬥牛士，滿是花哨與派頭。一顆咧嘴笑的白色骷髏從鑲金色編織帶的青綠色三角帽下向外窺視。他穿著鬥牛士的華服：短短的青綠色夾克，繡滿金色刺繡，胸前排著一排排鑲紅寶石的金飾和鑲滿金的大肩墊，一條別著紅寶石的白色領巾、紅色腰帶、帶金色條紋的緊身白褲和高高的青綠色靴子。一隻骨瘦如柴的手握著一把長長細細的彎劍，有金色的杯形護手，另一隻手拿著掛在棒上的紅色披風。早已死去，卻仍與危險共舞。

column1: A warrior archangel, stern and powerful. His skin is a fiery orange-red, his dark slate hair swept back from a hard, handsome face with sharp yellow-green eyes. A golden breastplate moulded to his muscular chest and stomach sits under ornate gold shoulder guards, with gold bracers and anklets; below it hangs a long white skirt bordered in gold diamonds, slit at the side, and he goes barefoot. Huge wings sweep up from his back, pale tan feathers in front and blazing orange behind. He carries a long iron spear. Every inch the commander of heaven's armies.
column2: 一位戰士大天使，嚴厲而強大。他的皮膚是火焰般的橙紅色，深板岩色的頭髮向後梳起，露出一張冷硬而英俊的臉，眼睛是銳利的黃綠色。一件貼合他肌肉結實胸腹的金色胸甲，戴在華麗的金色護肩之下，有金色護腕和腳環；下面垂著一條長長的白色裙，鑲著金色菱形的邊，側面開衩，他赤著腳。巨大的翅膀從背後向上掠起，前面是淡黃褐色羽毛，後面是熾烈的橙色。他持著一支長長的鐵矛。完完全全是天界軍隊的統帥。

column1: An eerie, pale serpent spirit in a slender human shape. Its head is a smooth, ridged white dome like a snake's or a grub's, with a thin slit of a mouth and no other face, framed by a fall of long black hair. Its lean body is chalk white, with a scaly mustard-yellow plate down the front, red stripes along its sides, and pink forearms and lower legs veined with white marks, ending in pink clawed hands and feet. A long, tapering ridged tail trails behind, and it carries a rough, pinkish-brown spear. Silent, alien and quietly unsettling.
column2: 一個詭異、蒼白的蛇靈，有著纖細的人形。頭是光滑、有脊紋的白色圓頂，像蛇或幼蟲，只有一條細細的嘴縫，沒有其他五官，被一簾長長的黑髮框著。精瘦的身體是粉筆般的白色，正面有一片鱗狀的芥末黃色甲片，兩側有紅色條紋，前臂和小腿是粉紅色，帶著白色紋路的血管，末端是粉紅色帶爪的手和腳。一條長長漸細、有脊紋的尾巴拖在後面，牠持著一支粗糙的粉棕色長矛。沉默、異形，隱隱令人不安。

column1: A fierce lion-headed god wrapped in a serpent. His body is a lean, muscular man's, skinned in deep crimson, and his head is a red lion's with piercing blue eyes and a thick, curling dark brown mane and beard. A huge snake banded in orange and black coils round and round him from ankles to shoulders, its dark head rising high above his own with a flicking red tongue. Two pairs of translucent rose-red feathered wings spread behind him, and he grips a dark hooked sickle in each hand. Solemn, kingly and coiled with power.
column2: 一位兇猛的獅頭神，被一條蛇纏繞著。他的身體是精瘦、肌肉結實的男人，皮膚深紅色，頭是紅色獅頭，有銳利的藍眼睛和濃密捲曲的深棕色鬃毛與鬍鬚。一條橙黑相間的巨蛇從腳踝到肩膀一圈一圈盤繞著他，深色的蛇頭高高昂起在他頭頂之上，吐著紅色的舌頭。兩對半透明玫瑰紅羽毛的翅膀在他身後展開，他兩手各握著一把深色的彎鉤鐮刀。莊嚴、王者之姿，盤繞著力量。

column1: A serene, ethereal youth rising out of a ball of rock. His slim, muscular upper body is a pale lavender-grey, his face delicate and cool with red eyes, framed by long golden hair that tumbles down in heavy corkscrew ringlets. A crested golden helmet like a sunburst fan sits on his head, and a gold armlet circles one arm. From the waist down he's sunk into a great black boulder, rough and pitted, carved all over with golden zodiac signs, a smooth pink crystal wedge opening at the front where his body meets it. Calm, cosmic and remote, he looks like the keeper of the heavens.
column2: 一位寧靜、飄逸的青年，從一團岩石球中升起。他纖細、肌肉結實的上身是淡薰衣草灰色，臉龐精緻冷峻，有紅色的眼睛，被長長的金髮框著，頭髮如沉重的螺旋捲髮傾瀉而下。頭上戴著一頂有冠羽的金色頭盔，像旭日般的扇形，一隻手臂上有金色臂環。腰部以下他沉入一塊巨大的黑色巨石，粗糙有坑，上面刻滿金色的黃道星座符號，身體與巨石相接處，前面開著一塊光滑的粉紅色水晶楔。平靜、宇宙般、遙遠，看起來像天界的守護者。

column1: A towering archangel who looks carved from silver and marble. His skin is a cold metallic grey, his swept-back golden hair falls to his neck, and his stern face has piercing green eyes and a small gold mark on the brow. Silvery plate armour trimmed in gold scrollwork covers his arms and legs, beneath a white robe draped over one shoulder and a long white tabard emblazoned with a tall gold cross, white ribbons hanging from a knotted sash. Great pale grey wings rise from his back, their upper tips ending in dark round knobs. Majestic, impassive and absolute, the very voice of heaven.
column2: 一位高聳的大天使，看起來像由銀與大理石雕成。他的皮膚是冰冷的金屬灰，向後梳起的金髮垂到脖子，嚴厲的臉上有銳利的綠色眼睛，眉心有一個小小的金色記號。銀色板甲鑲著金色渦卷花紋，覆蓋他的手臂和腿，下面是披在一邊肩膀的白色長袍和一件長長的白色外袍，上面繡著一個高高的金色十字，白色絲帶從打結的腰帶垂下。巨大的淡灰色翅膀從背後升起，上端末端是深色的圓球。莊嚴、無動於衷、絕對，是天堂本身的聲音。

column1: An armoured angel with no face at all. His head is a smooth gold helmet, rounded and blank, with a single ridge down the middle ending in a pointed, beak-like edge where a face should be. His sleek body is clad in vivid purple, with a white panel running down the chest and stomach, white bands at the shoulders and black at the joints. Ribbed gold gauntlets cover his forearms, huge segmented gold greaves his legs, and a spiked gold collar holds a round turquoise jewel at his chest. Behind him spread dark grey wings made of stiff, straight slats like shutters. Cold, mechanical and implacable.
column2: 一位披甲的天使，完全沒有臉。他的頭是一頂光滑的金色頭盔，圓而空白，一道單脊從中間貫穿，末端在本該是臉的位置成為一個尖尖的、像喙般的邊緣。他光滑的身體穿著鮮豔的紫色，胸腹有一道白色的飾板，肩部是白色帶，關節處是黑色。帶肋紋的金色護手覆蓋前臂，巨大分節的金色脛甲覆蓋雙腿，一個帶尖刺的金色項圈在胸前托著一顆圓形的青綠色寶石。他身後展開著由僵硬筆直的板條構成的深灰色翅膀，像百葉窗。冰冷、機械、無情。

column1: A gangly spirit of Aboriginal Australian legend that looks carved from green wood. Its head is a flat-topped block like a tree stump, the cut top showing reddish growth rings, with two big round staring white eyes and a thin, flat red-lipped mouth. Its body is lumpy and dark green, scored with grain-like cracks, with long dangling arms and stubby legs, and its only clothing is a white cloth tied loosely round its waist. In one hand it clutches a red boomerang tipped with yellow. Goofy at first glance, but those blank eyes and that flat mouth give it a creepy, sinister stillness.
column2: 一個瘦長的精靈，出自澳洲原住民傳說，看起來像由綠色木頭雕成。頭是一個平頂的方塊，像樹樁，切口頂面露出紅褐色的年輪，有兩隻瞪著的大圓白眼睛和一張細細扁平、嘴唇紅色的嘴。身體凹凸不平，是深綠色，布滿像木紋的裂痕，手臂長長垂下，腿短而粗，唯一的衣物是鬆鬆繫在腰間的一塊白布。一隻手緊握著一根紅色的迴力鏢，末端是黃色。乍看有點傻氣，但那空洞的眼睛和扁平的嘴，讓它有一種令人毛骨悚然的邪惡靜止感。

column1: A strange, fuzzy moth-creature, about as tall as a person. Its body is a plump, egg-shaped bundle of shaggy steel-blue fur perched on two long, spindly dark legs with clawed bird feet. Its round head has two glinting red eyes and a wide, flat black slot of a mouth, and two thin antennae curve up from it, tipped with little green and blue feathery fans. Its broad wings are plain blue on the back, but in front they blaze with big black-outlined eyespots on red and yellow, edged with dark green feathers. Bizarre and a little comic, but an omen in the night all the same.
column2: 一隻奇異、毛茸茸的蛾形生物，大約和人一樣高。身體是一團圓胖的蛋形鋼藍色蓬毛，立在兩條細長的深色腿上，是帶爪的鳥腳。圓圓的頭上有兩隻閃亮的紅眼睛和一道寬寬扁平的黑色縫狀嘴，兩根細細的觸角向上彎曲，頂端是小小的綠藍色羽狀扇。寬闊的翅膀背面是純藍色，正面則閃耀著帶黑色輪廓的大眼斑，底色是紅色和黃色，邊緣是深綠色羽毛。奇異而有點滑稽，但仍然是夜裡的預兆。

column1: A tall golden coffin that lives.
